info.title: PantherClaw Connect JSON API
info.description: Generated from the checked-in protobuf API. This describes the Connect JSON wire shape. Runtime authorization, plan state, step-up, tenant RLS and cross-field validation remain authoritative on the server. Gateway mTLS and streaming protocols need their dedicated integration tests.

post.description:
WhoAmI describes the authenticated caller, its bindings and the
 permissions it holds somewhere in the org.
 permission: authenticated

ListUsers lists the org's users.
 permission: user.read

GetUser returns one user.
 permission: user.read

SetUserState disables or re-enables a user. Disabling revokes the
 user's CLI sessions at once.
 permission: user.manage

CreateInvitation invites a person by email. The token is returned once.
 Inviting with roles also requires role.bind.
 permission: invitation.manage

ListInvitations lists invitations.
 permission: invitation.read

RevokeInvitation revokes a pending invitation.
 permission: invitation.manage

AcceptInvitation accepts an invitation in the browser (G0 UI D8,
 HR-352) for the signed-in account: only from an account or org
 browser session, once, before it expires, and only when the identity
 provider's verified email of the account equals the invitation's
 email (INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH otherwise). It returns the org the
 account joined; the session moves to that org on a fresh sign-in.
 permission: invitations.accept

ListRoles lists the default roles and their permissions.
 permission: authenticated

ListRoleBindings lists role bindings, optionally for one principal.
 permission: role.read

CreateRoleBinding grants a role to a principal at a scope.
 permission: role.bind

DeleteRoleBinding removes a role binding.
 permission: role.bind

ListMySessions lists the caller's browser and CLI sessions, newest
 first (at most 100).
 permission: authenticated

RevokeMySession ends one of the caller's sessions.
 permission: authenticated

ListMyKeys lists the caller's security keys and passkeys.
 permission: authenticated

ListUserSessions lists a user's sessions, newest first (at most 100).
 permission: user.read

ListUserKeys lists a user's security keys.
 permission: user.read

RevokeUserSessions ends every browser and CLI session of a user (for
 example when a laptop is lost). The user is told by email.
 permission: user.manage

RemoveUserKey removes a user's security key (a lost key). Administrators
 can never add one for someone else. The user is told by email.
 permission: user.manage

DeleteAccount deletes the signed-in hosted account (G0 M13 D34,
 HR-394): only from an account session whose sign-in is recent
 (RECENT_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED otherwise), and refused while the account is
 the last org admin of any active org (LAST_ADMIN). Its users in every
 org are disabled and pseudonymised ("deleted user <short id>"), its
 email and name are removed, and its sessions end. Evidence keeps
 opaque ids only.
 permission: account.delete

CreateAutomation creates a DRAFT automation and its execution identity.
 permission: automation.manage

GetAutomation returns an automation with its enabled version, ceiling
 and identity.
 permission: automation.read

ListAutomations lists automations by name.
 permission: automation.read

CreateDraftVersion stores a new DRAFT version from a definition.
 permission: automation.manage

UpdateDraftVersion replaces the definition of a version that is not
 published (it returns to DRAFT).
 permission: automation.manage

ValidateVersion validates a version: VALIDATED with its summary when it
 has no error findings, else DRAFT with the findings.
 permission: automation.manage

GetVersion returns a version's definition, digest, summary, findings
 and state.
 permission: automation.read

ListVersions lists an automation's versions, newest first.
 permission: automation.read

GetVersionGraph returns a version as a graph: trigger, conditions,
 steps, gates and finish conditions, each step linked to the authority
 it uses (F663).
 permission: automation.read

RequestEnable asks for a version to be enabled at a rollout stage, or
 for the enabled version to widen its rollout. It returns the change
 request people confirm on its page.
 permission: automation.manage

NarrowRollout narrows the enabled version's rollout (FULL to COHORT to
 SHADOW) at once; narrowing needs one person.
 permission: automation.manage

PauseAutomation stops new executions; active executions continue
 unless cancel_active is set.
 permission: automation.manage

ResumeAutomation revalidates the owner, ceiling, identity, principal,
 edition and kill switch, then resumes; missed irreversible work is
 never replayed.
 permission: automation.manage

RetireAutomation cancels active executions, retires the triggers and
 the ceiling and disables the identity. Final.
 permission: automation.manage

SetAutomationOwner makes another active person the owner. Pending
 enabling requests are voided: they were asked for under the previous
 owner.
 permission: automation.manage

RevokeAuthority revokes the ceiling and every grant issued under it,
 ends their runs and pauses the automation (AUTHORITY_REVOKED).
 permission: automation.manage

CreateAgent creates a claimed agent, subject to the edition's agent
 limit.
 permission: agent.manage

GetAgent returns an agent's summary (F017, F031, F624).
 permission: agent.read

ListAgents lists agents, discovered ones included.
 permission: agent.read

UpdateAgent changes an agent's name or purpose. The execution context
 never changes; a different context needs a new agent.
 permission: agent.manage

TransferOwnership changes the owner or backup owner. It is recorded and
 moves no runs, instances or grants (F574).
 permission: agent.manage

ClaimAgent turns a discovered agent into a claimed one, or merges its
 discovery into an existing agent (F035). Claiming grants nothing.
 permission: agent.manage

SuspendAgent suspends an agent: its instances get no workload tokens and
 its runs are denied. Outstanding permits fail BeginDispatch. Resuming
 needs an approved restoration (RequestAgentRestoration).
 permission: agent.manage

RetireAgent retires an agent for good: it revokes its instances and
 enrollment tokens and ends its runs (F023). Retiring a discovered agent
 dismisses its discovery.
 permission: agent.manage

ListAgentChanges returns an agent's append-only change history (F024).
 permission: agent.read

SubmitScanFindings records the findings of a local `pclaw scan` as
 DISCOVERED agents with ADMISSION entries (PN-001.1, F015); a finding
 submitted before is only counted. Findings are UNTRUSTED observations
 and grant nothing; credentials never leave the scanning machine. It is
 also served on the gateway listener, where a gateway holding an
 organization scan's org_scan lease submits that scan's findings and
 needs gateway.scan.submit instead (G0 M8, HR-209).
 permission: agent.manage

RequestAgentRestoration asks for a suspended agent to return to the
 state it was suspended from (F563). It creates a RESTORATION approval
 request and waitlist entry, decided on the approval page with a
 security key by an agent.restore holder other than the requester (G0 M5
 part 2 decision 11, HR-176). Only a person may ask, with a reason.
 permission: agent.manage

Authorize decides on one canonical action. On ALLOW it returns a
 single-use dispatch permit.
 permission: gateway.authorize

BeginDispatch is the commit point immediately before the gateway sends
 any byte to the target. Any error means: do not dispatch.
 permission: gateway.dispatch

RecordExecution records the outcome of one dispatched permit.
 permission: gateway.dispatch

GetNonce returns the org's current PAP/1 nonce, which the gateway
 serves to workloads in PAP-Nonce headers (HR-091).
 permission: gateway.authorize

ReportUnknownWorkload reports a request whose key-only proof verified
 but whose key is not an admitted instance (PAP-1 §4). The Authority
 re-verifies the proof and records a capped, deduplicated discovery
 (HR-148). The request itself is refused.
 permission: gateway.observe

VerifyWorkload checks a workload's PAP/1 credentials for a request
 that decides nothing, such as an MCP `tools/list` or `server/discover`
 (HR-021: the gateway never verifies a workload itself). The proof is
 consumed like any other; nothing is decided or recorded.
 permission: gateway.authorize

RecordToolObservation verifies a workload's PAP/1 credentials, as
 VerifyWorkload does, and records a tool call an agent SDK runs without
 a mapping (G0 M8, HR-200): OBSERVE_ONLY, with the tool's name
 (untrusted) and its input's digest, never the input. The connection
 must be one this gateway serves. A workload that does not verify, or a
 connection this gateway does not serve, is an answer with its code, and
 nothing is recorded.
 permission: gateway.observe

ListApprovalRequests lists the requests the caller may see, newest
 first. Holding approval.read is not required: the caller always sees
 the requests they may decide and their own runs' requests.
 permission: authenticated

GetApprovalRequest returns one request with its stored display, the
 untrusted evidence, the responses, the variant history and the
 caller's eligibility.
 permission: authenticated

DeclineApprovalRequest declines a pending request: the held action
 ends as DENY (APPROVAL_DECLINED). Needs a person signed in through a
 browser or the CLI who is eligible to decide it; the note is shown to
 people only (design decision 18).
 permission: approval.respond

RequestApprovalEvidence asks the run for evidence before an evidence
 deadline; the request waits in EVIDENCE_REQUESTED until evidence
 arrives or the evidence deadline passes (then DENY).
 permission: approval.respond

ProposeNarrowerAction proposes the same action with narrower material
 parameters (F147). The original action ends as DENY
 (NARROWER_PROPOSED); the agent may submit the proposal as a new
 action, which gets its own decision and approval. validate_only
 simulates it without ending anything.
 permission: approval.respond

SubmitApprovalEvidence adds an UNTRUSTED note from the run's launcher
 or represented principal (HR-172). It never changes the binding.
 permission: authenticated

DeclineApprovalBatch declines up to 25 pending requests for one
 operation at once; each gets its own response and audit event
 (HR-175, Team edition).
 permission: approval.respond

SetTestCases replaces a DRAFT or VALIDATED version's scenario tests.
 permission: automation.manage

ListTestCases lists a version's scenario tests.
 permission: automation.read

RunTests runs a version's tests; a passing run makes a VALIDATED
 version TESTED.
 permission: automation.manage

GetTestRun returns a test run with each case's result.
 permission: automation.read

StartAutomationSimulation queues a historical simulation of a version over at
 most 30 days.
 permission: automation.manage

GetAutomationSimulation returns a simulation's state and results.
 permission: automation.read

GetRolloutReport reports an automation's rollout stage and its shadow
 and cohort outcomes, and whether FULL rollout is verified.
 permission: automation.read

GetAutomationStatus returns an automation's next run, latest verified
 outcome, ceiling budgets and backlog (F283).
 permission: automation.read

InspectVersion lists, per consequential step, its operations, their
 effects, reversibility and consequences, coverage per ceiling agent,
 the approvals it requires and how its effects are verified (F710).
 permission: automation.read

PreviewBlastRadius previews what a version's authority could reach
 (Business; the caller's exposure.read applies).
 permission: automation.read

CompareRestriction compares a version's ceiling with a narrower one
 (Business; the caller's exposure.read applies).
 permission: automation.read

GetAutomationMetrics returns hourly automation outcomes.
 permission: automation.read

GetExecution returns one execution with everything it caused.
 permission: automation.read

ListExecutions lists executions, newest first.
 permission: automation.read

LookupExecution finds the execution that caused a run, a grant or a
 transaction (drill-down from investigations and search).
 permission: automation.read

CancelExecution stops an active execution at its next boundary: its
 grants are revoked, its runs ended and its pending launches, gates and
 deliveries cancelled (HR-283). It returns the verified effect.
 permission: automation.manage

CancelActiveExecutions cancels every active execution of an
 automation.
 permission: automation.manage

ClaimLaunch claims the oldest pending launch for the caller's agent.
 permission: workload.run

CompleteLaunch reports a claimed launch's outcome; only the claiming
 instance may.
 permission: workload.run

ListTemplates lists the templates.
 permission: automation.read

GetTemplate returns a template's definition, parameters and baseline
 tests.
 permission: automation.read

CreateFromTemplate creates a DRAFT automation from a template: its
 execution identity, a DRAFT version rendered from the parameters, and
 the template's baseline tests for that version.
 permission: automation.manage

ListProposals lists proposals, newest first.
 permission: automation.read

DecideProposal accepts or declines an open proposal.
 permission: automation.manage

PreviewSchedule lists a schedule's next occurrences in its zone, with
 what daylight saving does to each.
 permission: automation.read

StartExecution starts an automation whose enabled version has a manual
 trigger. A version that requires a step-up answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED
 here; start it on its page.
 permission: automation.run

RetryExecution starts a failed, partially completed or cancelled
 execution of the enabled version again with its parameters (a new
 manual trigger), unless an irreversible effect is unknown.
 permission: automation.run

GetTrigger returns one trigger record.
 permission: automation.read

ListTriggers lists an automation's trigger records, newest first.
 permission: automation.read

CreateEventSource creates a PENDING inbound event source and returns
 its signing secret once.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

ActivateEventSource activates a source; it needs a step-up, so over
 the API it answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED (use confirm_url).
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

RotateEventSourceSecret replaces a source's secret; it needs a
 step-up, so over the API it answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

DisableEventSource disables a source for good.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

GetEventSource returns one source.
 permission: automation.read

ListEventSources lists the org's sources.
 permission: automation.read

CreateAutomationDestination creates a PENDING destination and returns
 its signing secret once.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

ActivateAutomationDestination activates a destination; it needs a
 step-up, so over the API it answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

RotateAutomationDestinationSecret replaces a destination's signing
 secret; it needs a step-up, so over the API it answers
 STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

SetAutomationDestinationState pauses, resumes or disables a
 destination.
 permission: automation.endpoints.manage

GetAutomationDestination returns one destination.
 permission: automation.read

ListAutomationDestinations lists the org's destinations.
 permission: automation.read

OpenCase opens a case about the subjects, with the questions open.
 permission: case.manage

AppendCaseEntry adds one entry to a case.
 permission: case.manage

GetCase returns a case and a page of its entries.
 permission: case.read

ListCases lists the cases the caller may read, most recently updated
 first.
 permission: case.read

GetCaseLens returns one lens of a case, with one selection and time
 range shared by every lens. Rows of agents outside the caller's
 evidence.read scope are left out before anything is counted.
 permission: case.read

ExportCase exports a case for handoff as canonical JSON with entry
 hashes and evidence ids. It also needs evidence.export over the case
 and is audited.
 permission: case.read

GetChangeRequest returns a request with its confirmations.
 permission: authenticated

ListChangeRequests lists requests the caller may see, newest first.
 permission: authenticated

DeclineChangeRequest declines a pending request (its requester, or a
 person eligible to confirm it).
 permission: authenticated

PromoteAgent promotes an agent in its PRODUCTION environment for each
 operation whose checks pass, provisionally (7 days) when only coverage
 is pending; the others are reported with the checks they failed.
 Needs a fresh step-up.
 permission: agent.promote

RevokePromotion revokes an ACTIVE promotion: new and widened grants for
 its operation are refused from now on; existing grants are untouched.
 permission: agent.promote

GetReadiness runs every check for each operation of an agent in an
 environment, and names its ACTIVE promotion when it has one.
 permission: agent.read

ListPromotions lists promotions, newest first.
 permission: agent.read
permission: cohort.manage

UpdateFleetCohort replaces a cohort's name, description, owner, rule
 and baseline.
 permission: cohort.manage

DeleteFleetCohort deletes a cohort and its memberships; its agents are
 untouched.
 permission: cohort.manage
permission: agent.read

ListFleetCohorts lists cohorts by name.
 permission: agent.read

ListFleetCohortMembers lists a cohort's agents, static and matched.
 permission: agent.read

AddFleetCohortMembers adds agents to a cohort's static members.
 permission: cohort.manage
permission: cohort.manage

SetAgentTaskType sets or clears the task type cohort rules match.
 permission: cohort.manage

GetCohortQueue lists what a cohort needs from a person: unowned or
 unpromoted agents, grants beyond its baseline and pending approvals.
 permission: agent.read

GetCohortChanges lists what moved for a cohort's agents since a time
 (at most 31 days back): members, grants, policy versions, package
 activations and promotions.
 permission: agent.read

GetFleetOverview lists every agent the caller may read with its owner,
 last run, promoted operations and active grants; no cohort needed.
 permission: agent.read

ProveIdentity links the caller's own GitHub account, or with unlink
 removes that link, once the server has read from GitHub which account
 a user access token from GitHub sign-in belongs to: the proof that the
 caller controls it (G0 M8 P2f, founder decision 2026-10-13). The
 token is never stored. A GitHub user id links to one person; every
 change is audited and notified.
 permission: github.identity.prove

GetSignIn says where to sign in to GitHub to prove an account: the
 GitHub App's client id and GitHub's web origin for its device flow
 (P2f). Unavailable when GitHub sign-in is off.
 permission: github.identity.prove

UnlinkIdentity removes another person's link; nobody removes their own
 here (ProveIdentity). Audited and notified.
 permission: github.identity.manage

ListIdentities lists the links, of one person or of everyone.
 permission: user.read

ExemptAccount registers a GitHub account that is not a person (a bot or
 a machine user): linked to nobody, it does not stop the independent
 approvals of pull requests it worked on, as an unlinked person does
 (GITHUB_PEOPLE_NOT_LINKED; founder decision 2026-10-13). Audited and
 notified.
 permission: github.identity.manage

RemoveExemption removes an account's exemption. Audited and notified.
 permission: github.identity.manage

ListExemptions lists the org's exemptions (at most 500).
 permission: user.read

StartOrgScan starts a scan of the GitHub organization behind a GitHub
 App connection (PN-001.2, HR-209; Team edition): an org_scan lease for
 the connection's gateway, which reads metadata and named files only and
 submits what it finds. One scan of a connection runs at a time.
 permission: github.scan.run

GetOrgScan returns a scan: its state, its counts, and the sources it
 read and could not read.
 permission: github.scan.run

ListOrgScanFindings lists what a scan found: untrusted observations,
 recorded as DISCOVERED agents, that grant nothing.
 permission: github.scan.run

CreateConnection registers a connection. Its routes start in its
 default mode, monitor unless enforce is asked for.
 permission: connection.manage

GetConnection returns a connection with its route modes and its active
 credential's metadata.
 permission: connection.read

ListConnections lists the org's connections.
 permission: connection.read

UpdateConnection changes the fields that are set, at the revision the
 caller read. Changing the target, hosts, gateway, package or access
 mode, or lowering the default mode to monitor, is a weakening change.
 permission: connection.manage

SetRouteMode sets one route's mode; enforce to monitor is a weakening
 change.
 permission: connection.manage

QuarantineConnection stops every action through a connection at once.
 permission: connection.manage

RestoreConnection lifts a quarantine (a weakening change).
 permission: connection.manage

RetireConnection ends a connection for good and revokes its credential.
 permission: connection.manage

GetSealingKey returns what `pclaw seal` needs: the active broker key of
 the connection's gateway and the values a seal must bind.
 permission: credential.seal

PutCredential stores a sealed credential as the connection's next
 version; the previous version is superseded.
 permission: credential.seal

ListCredentials lists a connection's credentials (metadata only).
 permission: connection.read

RevokeCredential revokes the active credential at once.
 permission: connection.manage

GetConnectionCapabilities returns what a connection declares it
 supports: discovery, observation, enforcement and response, its
 operations, permissions with reasons, limits, failure behavior and its
 last successful test (F346). It is a declared capability, never
 coverage: what a target declares is not evidence until a test shows it
 (HR-210).
 permission: connection.read

TestConnection tests a connection and records the result; the latest
 passed test is its last successful test (F350, F354). A credential test
 checks what the connection depends on (its state, its gateway and the
 gateway's certificate, its pinned package and routes, its credential,
 its circuits) without calling the target, and finishes at once. A read
 test leases the package's one harmless test read (an HTTP GET with no
 required params) to the connection's gateway and is PENDING until the
 gateway reports: never a write.
 permission: connection.test

GetConnectionHealth returns what a person needs to judge a connection
 (F358): its circuits, the permissions its credential is used for, its
 latest and last successful tests, its delivery failures over the last
 24 hours and, for a caller who may read agents, the agents that used it
 over the last 30 days.
 permission: connection.read

GetKillSwitch returns the kill switch, the containment epoch and any
 pending restore proposal.
 permission: containment.read

GetCoverage returns one scope's record as it reads now.
 permission: coverage.read

ListCoverage lists the current record of every scope, by scope.
 permission: coverage.read

ListRoutes lists the route inventory. A route kind without an
 entry is not observed, never absent (F450).
 permission: coverage.read

GetClosure returns one closure evidence record (F457).
 permission: coverage.read

ListClosures lists closure evidence, newest first.
 permission: coverage.read

GetFreshnessContract publishes when evidence stops supporting a claim
 and what invalidates it (F440).
 permission: coverage.read

GetSnapshot returns one recorded coverage snapshot: the scope's
 computed record and the ledger entry it is bound to (HR-217).
 permission: coverage.read

ListSnapshots lists a scope's recorded snapshots, newest first: its
 coverage history.
 permission: coverage.read

Reassess recomputes the scopes of one connection now, from evidence,
 and records a snapshot for each that changed.
 permission: coverage.reassess

CreateExclusion records, until it expires, that a person accepts a scope
 or a route kind as outside the boundary (HR-212). It never raises a
 state: an excluded route still counts as open (design decision 1). Only
 a person makes one, with a written reason; it is audited, notified to
 org admins and listed with every claim on the scope.
 permission: coverage.manage

RevokeExclusion ends an active exclusion at once.
 permission: coverage.manage

ListExclusions lists exclusions, newest first.
 permission: coverage.read

GetAccessDetail says where an agent gets usable authority at a
 connection's target and what limits it (§39.2–39.3): the custodian and
 modes, the scope and audience, the expiry, the issuance source, the
 affected agents, the verification basis, the routes still open, and
 what each mode must disclose. It never shows a secret.
 permission: coverage.read

ListFindings lists exposure findings, starting with credential
 overreach (F048): reach a credential holds beyond what the operations
 need, shown as exposure, never as extra permission.
 permission: coverage.read

AcknowledgeFinding acknowledges an open finding with a written reason,
 which dismisses it; it is audited, and the finding stays dismissed
 when seen again with the same excess.
 permission: coverage.manage

CreateExport asks for an export of the whole org. Human only;
 audited; a fresh step-up of this browser session is required
 (STEP_UP_REQUIRED otherwise). At most one export is building at a
 time (EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS).
 permission: data.export

GetDataRequest returns an export or a deletion request.
 permission: data_requests.read

ListDataRequests lists the org's exports and deletion requests, newest
 first.
 permission: data_requests.read

RequestDeletion asks for the deletion of the whole org, after a 7-day
 window in which any org admin can cancel it. Human only; audited; a
 fresh step-up of this browser session is required (STEP_UP_REQUIRED
 otherwise). Refused while an org-wide legal hold is active
 (DELETION_HELD) or while another deletion request is open
 (DELETION_PENDING).
 permission: org.delete

CancelDeletion cancels a deletion request inside its window. Human
 only; audited; every org admin is told.
 permission: org.delete

GetDeletionRecord returns the signed record of a deleted org to the
 hosted account that requested the deletion (account sessions only).
 permission: deletion_records.read

ListRules lists the built-in rules and the org's custom rules with
 their state.
 permission: detection.read

GetDetectionStatus says how far detection has read the org's feed.
 permission: detection.read

CreateCustomRule stores a DRAFT custom rule version (Business; a person
 only).
 permission: detection.manage

TestCustomRule runs a custom rule version's tests and records the run.
 permission: detection.manage

PublishCustomRule re-runs the tests and publishes the version when at
 least one firing and one non-firing test pass; a published older
 version of the same rule is disabled (Business; a person only).
 permission: detection.manage

DisableCustomRule disables a custom rule version (a person only).
 permission: detection.manage

EnableRule turns a rule the engine disabled after repeated evaluation
 errors back on (a person only).
 permission: detection.manage

CreateEnforcementPoint creates a PENDING point proposing its
 connections; a person activates it at confirm_url.
 permission: enforcement_point.manage

ActivateEnforcementPoint confirms a point's proposed connections; it
 needs a step-up, so over the API it answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED (use
 confirm_url).
 permission: enforcement_point.manage

UpdateEnforcementPointConnections replaces a point's connections: a
 set within the current one applies at once, any other is proposed and
 waits for a confirmation at confirm_url.
 permission: enforcement_point.manage

DisableEnforcementPoint disables a point for good.
 permission: enforcement_point.manage

GetEnforcementPoint returns one point.
 permission: enforcement_point.manage

ListEnforcementPoints lists the org's points by name (at most 100).
 permission: enforcement_point.manage

GetEntitlements returns the org's plan, status, limits and usage.
 permission: entitlements.read

ListCheckpoints lists the org's checkpoints, newest first, and its
 integrity status.
 permission: evidence.read

GetCheckpoint returns one checkpoint, or the latest.
 permission: evidence.read

GetInclusionProof proves that the entry at a sequence number is in a
 checkpoint's tree (RFC 9162).
 permission: evidence.read

GetConsistencyProof proves that a checkpoint's tree extends a smaller
 one (RFC 9162).
 permission: evidence.read

ExportBundle builds a pantherclaw.bundle/v1 verify bundle.
 permission: evidence.read

ListAnchors lists the anchors of the global root that hold one of the
 org's checkpoints, newest first (design decision 12, HR-195).
 permission: evidence.read

ReplayDecision runs one evaluation of a transaction again on its
 recorded inputs, at the recorded time, with the recorded policy or a
 stored policy version (design decision 11, F504–F508). It writes no
 transaction, receipt, reservation, permit or audit event and calls no
 gateway (HR-197). It needs evidence.read where the transaction's agent
 lives, like run.read; the input values themselves need
 evidence.read_restricted there too. At most 10 replays per minute per
 caller.
 permission: evidence.read

CreateEvidencePack asks for a signed evidence pack of a scope (design
 decision 15, F525–F532, Team edition). A job builds it from the
 creator's permissions at that moment: what they cannot read is left
 out and counted as a gap. Human only; audited.
 permission: evidence.export

GetEvidencePack returns a pack's state and, when ready, its signed
 manifest: to its creator, or to a holder of evidence.read at org scope.
 permission: evidence.read

ListEvidencePacks lists the packs the caller may see, newest first.
 permission: evidence.read

GetRetentionPolicies returns each category's current retention, its
 bounds, and a shortening that has not taken effect yet.
 permission: evidence.retention.manage

SetRetentionPolicy records a new revision of one category's retention.
 A longer period applies at once; a shorter one 7 days later.
 permission: evidence.retention.manage

CreateLegalHold places a hold that blocks every removal inside its
 scope, at once.
 permission: evidence.retention.manage

ReleaseLegalHold releases an active hold; retention then applies to
 what it held.
 permission: evidence.retention.manage

ListLegalHolds lists the org's holds, newest first.
 permission: evidence.retention.manage

CreateCaptureProfile switches payload capture on for some connections
 and operations, with a purpose and limits. It is audited, notified to
 the org's admins and auditors, and reaches the gateways serving those
 connections in their configuration.
 permission: evidence.capture.manage

ListCaptureProfiles lists the org's capture profiles, newest first.
 permission: evidence.capture.manage

DisableCaptureProfile stops a profile at once (audited and notified).
 permission: evidence.capture.manage

ReadPayloadCapture returns one captured body. The read (who, which
 capture, the reason) is written to the audit ledger before the
 content is returned.
 permission: evidence.read_restricted

GetExposure lists the current snapshot's rights the caller may see.
 permission: exposure.read

GetReachMatrix folds the visible rights into agents x resource groups
 x verbs per view (F256); each cell explains its verb.
 permission: exposure.read

RankExposure orders the visible agents by consequence, scope, present
 usability, enforceability, ownership and remediation readiness, each
 key shown; there is no single score (F257).
 permission: exposure.read

ListCredentialDependents lists every workload whose reach goes through
 a connection's credential (F260, F430); needs exposure.read at org
 scope.
 permission: exposure.read

PreviewReduction computes reach before and after an authority
 reduction on live data and stores nothing (F259); needs exposure.read
 at org scope.
 permission: exposure.read

GetGraph builds a graph from a scope.
 permission: exposure.read

ListGraphEdges lists the same graph's edges as a table.
