 over the API it answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED (use confirm_url).
 permission: support.manage

ListSupportGrants lists the organization's support grants, newest
 first.
 permission: support.read

RevokeSupportGrant ends a grant now, and every support session under
 it. Revoking only removes access, so it needs no step-up.
 permission: support.manage

ListBreakGlassHolders lists the designated holders.
 permission: breakglass.read

SetBreakGlassHolders replaces the designated holders (at most three).
 A removed holder's activation ends at once.
 permission: breakglass.manage

ActivateBreakGlass activates the caller's emergency role. It needs a
 step-up, so over the API it answers STEP_UP_REQUIRED (use the page
 /break-glass/activate).
 permission: authenticated

EndBreakGlass ends an activation early: the holder's own, or any one
 for a caller holding breakglass.manage.
 permission: authenticated

GetMyBreakGlass says whether the caller is a holder and whether their
 activation is in force, for the console's banner.
 permission: authenticated

ListBreakGlassActivations lists activations, newest first.
 permission: breakglass.read

GetBuildInfo returns the server's build identity.
 permission: public

GetOrg returns the caller's organization.
 permission: org.read

UpdateOrg renames the organization.
 permission: org.update

CreateOrg creates an organization for the signed-in account (hosted
 self-serve, D8): only from an account browser session with a verified
 email while self-serve sign-up is on (else SIGNUP_DISABLED), within the
 per-account limits (ACCOUNT_ORG_LIMIT) and rate limits. The account
 becomes the org's first user with Org Admin, the accepted terms and DPA
 versions are recorded, and the session is rotated into the new org.
 permission: orgs.create

ListMyOrgs lists the organizations the signed-in account is an active
 member of, through the audited cross-org lister (HR-349).
 permission: orgs.list_mine

CreateBusinessUnit creates a business unit (Business edition).
 permission: business_unit.manage

GetBusinessUnit returns one business unit.
 permission: business_unit.read

ListBusinessUnits lists the business units the caller may read.
 permission: business_unit.read

UpdateBusinessUnit changes a business unit's name or description.
 permission: business_unit.manage

ArchiveBusinessUnit archives an empty business unit.
 permission: business_unit.manage

CreateTeam creates a team under the org or a business unit.
 permission: team.manage

GetTeam returns one team.
 permission: team.read

ListTeams lists the teams the caller may read.
 permission: team.read

UpdateTeam changes a team's name or description.
 permission: team.manage

ArchiveTeam archives a team without active environments.
 permission: team.manage

AddTeamMember adds a user to a team.
 permission: team.members.manage

RemoveTeamMember removes a user from a team.
 permission: team.members.manage

ListTeamMembers lists a team's members.
 permission: team.read

CreateEnvironment creates an environment under the org or a team.
 permission: environment.manage

GetEnvironment returns one environment.
 permission: environment.read

ListEnvironments lists the environments the caller may read.
 permission: environment.read

UpdateEnvironment changes an environment's name or description.
 permission: environment.manage

ArchiveEnvironment archives an environment.
 permission: environment.manage

ListTransactions lists transactions, newest first.
 permission: evidence.read

GetTransactionEvidence returns everything recorded about one
 transaction (the evidence explorer).
 permission: evidence.read

ListReconciliations lists reconciliations, newest first.
 permission: evidence.read

GetReconciliation returns one reconciliation and its transaction.
 permission: evidence.read

ResolveOccurred records, with a written basis, that the effect
 happened. For an unknown outcome the held budget is committed and an
 exact repeat stays refused within the repeat window; a conflicting
 effect's committed budget stays committed. It only ever commits, the
 safe direction.
 permission: transaction.reconcile

RequestVerification asks the transaction's verifier to read the target
 again now.
 permission: transaction.reconcile

LinkTransaction links a later, separately authorized transaction to an
 earlier one as its compensation or recovery. The earlier transaction's
 records and budget never change; it becomes COMPENSATED only once the
 compensating effect is confirmed.
 permission: transaction.reconcile

ListUsage returns the org's last days days, today included, newest
 first. Days the server has not metered are left out.
 permission: entitlements.read

ListWaitlistEntries lists waitlist entries, by priority then deadline.
 permission: waitlist.read

GetWaitlistEntry returns one entry.
 permission: waitlist.read

AssignWaitlistEntry marks the caller, an eligible decider of the entry,
 as working on it, or clears that. Assignment only shows who is working
 on an entry; it never changes who may decide.
 permission: waitlist.read

RequestAccess files an access request for a run's grant (F051), from
 the run's launcher or represented principal. It grants nothing: the
 grant's issuer decides through GrantService.ReviseGrant citing the
 entry, or dismisses it (HR-176).
 permission: authenticated

DismissAccessRequest closes an access request without changing the
 grant. The caller must be allowed to issue the run's grant.
 permission: grant.issue

GetEscalationChain returns the chain that applies to a team (or the
 org's), with the default when none is set.
 permission: waitlist.read

SetEscalationChain replaces the org's or a team's chain with a new
 revision (at most 5 steps, decision 8). Steps add deciders at wider
 scopes; none makes anyone eligible (HR-173). Audited.
 permission: waitlist.manage

GetWaitlistSettings returns the org's effective waitlist settings.
 permission: waitlist.manage

UpdateWaitlistSettings changes them: deadlines may only be shortened,
 hold caps only lowered (the grant cap up to 100) and approver cooldowns
 only lengthened (decisions 5-7); the batch ceilings start empty
 (decision 9). Audited.
 permission: waitlist.manage

GetWaitlistMetrics reports response and decision times, expiry,
 escalation and routing failures per kind and per decider over at most
 90 days, from the entries the caller may read (T-042, Team edition).
 permission: waitlist.read

Enroll registers the workload's key as an instance of an agent, with an
 owner's enrollment token or an attestation token that matches an
 auto-admitting issuer entry (PAP-1 §3.2). The org comes from the
 enrollment token or the attestation audience.
 permission: workload.enroll

IssueToken issues a workload token to an admitted instance whose key
 signed the proof; an attestation token renews L2 (HR-143).
 permission: workload.token

StartChildRun starts a child run of the caller's active run. The child
 inherits the represented principal and cannot outlive its parent.
 permission: workload.run

DelegateGrant gives a child run of the caller's run part of the
 caller's run's grant (HR-045, HR-047, HR-161). The delegated grant must
 fit inside its parent and every guardrail, expire no later than its
 parent and stay within the depth, fan-out and lifetime caps. The child
 shares its ancestors' budgets and may set smaller limits of its own.
 permission: workload.delegate

Wait long-polls a held transaction of the caller's run (the wait handle
 is the transaction id, G0 M5 part 2 design decision 15). It answers as
 soon as the state differs from known_state, or after at most 30
 seconds, with states, codes and times only: never approver identities,
 notes or the display (HR-174). Waiting never extends a deadline or
 dispatches anything; on READY the agent resubmits the identical action.
 At most 4 waits per instance and 1,000 per server run at once
 (ResourceExhausted with a retry time beyond them).
 permission: workload.run

SubmitEvidence adds an UNTRUSTED note to the open approval request of a
 held transaction of the caller's run (HR-172). It never changes the
 binding; an EVIDENCE_REQUESTED request returns to PENDING.
 permission: workload.run

RequestAccess files an access request for the caller's run's grant,
 citing one of the run's denials whose decisive reason is about scope
 (decision 10). At most 3 per run; the note is UNTRUSTED. It grants
 nothing (HR-176).
 permission: workload.run

pantherclaw.v1.AccountState.title: AccountState
pantherclaw.v1.AccountState.description: AccountState is the state of a user or service account.

pantherclaw.v1.CallerSessionKind.title: CallerSessionKind
pantherclaw.v1.CallerSessionKind.description:
CallerSessionKind is how a WhoAmI caller is signed in (SessionKind in
 account.proto is how one session was created).

pantherclaw.v1.Deployment.title: Deployment
pantherclaw.v1.Deployment.description: Deployment is the kind of deployment a server runs as.

pantherclaw.v1.InvitationState.title: InvitationState
pantherclaw.v1.InvitationState.description: InvitationState is the state of an invitation.

pantherclaw.v1.PrincipalType.title: PrincipalType
pantherclaw.v1.PrincipalType.description: PrincipalType distinguishes people from service accounts.

pantherclaw.v1.ScopeType.title: ScopeType
pantherclaw.v1.ScopeType.description: ScopeType is a level of the hierarchy a role is bound at.

pantherclaw.v1.AcceptInvitationRequest.title: AcceptInvitationRequest
pantherclaw.v1.AcceptInvitationRequest.description:
AcceptInvitationRequest carries the invitation token from the
 invitation link.

pantherclaw.v1.AcceptInvitationResponse.title: AcceptInvitationResponse
pantherclaw.v1.AcceptInvitationResponse.description: AcceptInvitationResponse names the org the account joined.

email.title: email
email.description: Invitee email; the identity provider must assert it at acceptance.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Roles to grant at org scope on acceptance.

token.title: token
token.description: The single-use token (pci_…). It is shown only once.

pantherclaw.v1.CreateInvitationResponse.title: CreateInvitationResponse
pantherclaw.v1.CreateInvitationResponse.description: CreateInvitationResponse returns the invitation and its token.

selfGrant.title: self_grant
selfGrant.description: Whether the caller granted the role to itself (audited).

email.title: email
email.description: Invitee email; empty only for a bootstrap invitation.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Roles granted at org scope on acceptance.

bootstrap.title: bootstrap
bootstrap.description: Whether this is the operator-created bootstrap invitation.

pantherclaw.v1.Invitation.title: Invitation
pantherclaw.v1.Invitation.description:
Invitation invites one person (or, for the bootstrap token, the first
 administrator) to join the org.

includeClosed.title: include_closed
includeClosed.description: Also list accepted, revoked and expired invitations.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

principalType.title: principal_type
principalType.description: Only bindings of this principal type (set together with principal_id).

principalId.title: principal_id
principalId.description: Only bindings of this user or service account.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

pantherclaw.v1.ListRolesRequest.title: ListRolesRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ListRolesRequest.description: ListRolesRequest asks for the role catalog.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

displayName.title: display_name
displayName.description: Email (users) or name (service accounts), for display.

pantherclaw.v1.Principal.title: Principal
pantherclaw.v1.Principal.description: Principal identifies a user or a service account.

scopeTypes.title: scope_types
scopeTypes.description: Scope types the role may be bound at.

humanOnly.title: human_only
humanOnly.description: Whether only users may hold the role.

pantherclaw.v1.RoleBinding.title: RoleBinding
pantherclaw.v1.RoleBinding.description: RoleBinding grants one role to one principal at one scope.

id.title: id
id.description: Business unit, team or environment id; empty for the org scope.

pantherclaw.v1.Scope.title: Scope
pantherclaw.v1.Scope.description:
Scope is where a role binding applies: the org, or one business unit,
 team or environment and everything below it.

pantherclaw.v1.SetUserStateRequest.title: SetUserStateRequest
pantherclaw.v1.SetUserStateRequest.description: SetUserStateRequest disables or re-enables a user.

displayName.title: display_name
displayName.description: Display name from the identity provider.

pantherclaw.v1.User.title: User
pantherclaw.v1.User.description: User is one OIDC identity in the org.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: Permissions held somewhere in the org (after API key scopes).

deployment.title: deployment
deployment.description:
The kind of deployment the server runs as (config `deployment`); a
 console shows a permanent banner outside production (HR-346).

sessionKind.title: session_kind
sessionKind.description:
Whether the caller holds a bearer credential or a browser session, and
 which kind of session.

accountId.title: account_id
accountId.description: The hosted account of an account browser session; empty otherwise.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol. Optional; when present it must be "1", and an empty value counts as absent.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

google.protobuf.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message.

pantherclaw.v1.KeyState.title: KeyState
pantherclaw.v1.KeyState.description: KeyState is the state of a security key.

pantherclaw.v1.SessionKind.title: SessionKind
pantherclaw.v1.SessionKind.description: SessionKind says how a session was created.

pantherclaw.v1.DeleteAccountRequest.title: DeleteAccountRequest
pantherclaw.v1.DeleteAccountRequest.description: DeleteAccountRequest is empty: it deletes the caller's own account.

pantherclaw.v1.RevokeMySessionRequest.title: RevokeMySessionRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RevokeMySessionRequest.description: RevokeMySessionRequest names one of the caller's sessions.

id.title: id
id.description: Key id (not the WebAuthn credential id).

synced.title: synced
synced.description: A passkey that can sync between devices.

stateReason.title: state_reason
stateReason.description: Why it is not active (CLONE_SUSPECTED, USER_REMOVED, ADMIN_REMOVED).

transports.title: transports
transports.description: Transports the authenticator reported (usb, nfc, internal, ...).

pantherclaw.v1.SecurityKey.title: SecurityKey
pantherclaw.v1.SecurityKey.description: SecurityKey is a WebAuthn credential (security key or passkey).

device.title: device
device.description:
For browser sessions, the user agent the server saw; for CLI sessions,
 the device name pclaw reported. Untrusted.

clientAddress.title: client_address
clientAddress.description: For browser sessions, the address the server saw. Untrusted.

active.title: active
active.description: Whether the session can still be used.

endReason.title: end_reason
endReason.description:
Why it ended (LOGOUT, REVOKED, ADMIN_REVOKED, IDLE, EXPIRED, REUSE,
 SESSION_LIMIT, REFRESH_REUSE, ...), empty while active.

pantherclaw.v1.Session.title: Session
pantherclaw.v1.Session.description: Session is one browser or CLI session.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationCeilingState.title: AutomationCeilingState
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationCeilingState.description: AutomationCeilingState is an issuance ceiling's state.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationKind.title: AutomationKind
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationKind.description: AutomationKind says what an automation is for.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationRollout.title: AutomationRollout
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationRollout.description: AutomationRollout is how far an enabled version reaches.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationState.title: AutomationState
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationState.description: AutomationState is an automation's lifecycle state.

cohortAgents.title: cohort_agents
cohortAgents.description: COHORT rollout: the agents it is live for.

pauseReason.title: pause_reason
pauseReason.description:
PAUSED: USER, KILL_SWITCH, CEILING_VOID, CEILING_EXPIRED,
 OWNER_INACTIVE, CONTAINED, COMPROMISED_PUBLISHER, AUTHORITY_REVOKED,
 COVERAGE_RECOVERY or LOOP.

ceiling.title: ceiling
ceiling.description: The ACTIVE ceiling, when there is one.

digest.title: digest
digest.description: SHA-256 of the version's canonical definition.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationCeiling.title: AutomationCeiling
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationCeiling.description: AutomationCeiling is the issuance ceiling of an enabled version.

deliveriesNotVerified.title: deliveries_not_verified
deliveriesNotVerified.description:
Deliveries already handed to a receiver whose cancellation could not be
 confirmed (D97, D102): they may still arrive.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationControlEffect.title: AutomationControlEffect
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationControlEffect.description: AutomationControlEffect is what a control verifiably did (HR-283).

type.title: type
type.description: NEXT, ON_FAILURE, COMPENSATE, FINISHES or USES.

type.title: type
type.description: TRIGGER, CONDITION, STEP, GATE or FINISH.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: The step kind or trigger kind.

authority.title: authority
authority.description: The authority the node uses: "ceiling" bounds or a platform scope.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationGraphNode.title: AutomationGraphNode
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationGraphNode.description: AutomationGraphNode is one node of a version graph.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationIdentity.title: AutomationIdentity
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationIdentity.description: AutomationIdentity is an automation in the agent inventory (D15).

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationVersion.title: AutomationVersion
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationVersion.description: AutomationVersion is one version of an automation.

versions.title: versions
versions.description: Versions without their definitions, newest first.

cancelActive.title: cancel_active
cancelActive.description: Also cancel the active executions at their next boundary.

cohortAgents.title: cohort_agents
cohortAgents.description: COHORT: the agents (a subset of the ceiling's), or a fleet cohort.

changeRequestId.title: change_request_id
changeRequestId.description: The change request to confirm on /changes/{id}.

required.title: required
required.description: How many people must confirm (1 or 2).

baseDigest.title: base_digest
baseDigest.description:
The digest the caller edited; a different stored digest refuses
 (REVISION_CHANGED).

pantherclaw.v1.ExecutionContext.title: ExecutionContext
pantherclaw.v1.ExecutionContext.description:
ExecutionContext is where an agent's instances run. Desktop instances are
 capped at L1 (HR-092).

name.title: name
name.description: Display name; not unique and never used to bind identity.

ownerUserId.title: owner_user_id
ownerUserId.description: Accountable owner (a user); empty while discovered.

suspendedFrom.title: suspended_from
suspendedFrom.description: For a suspended agent, the state it was suspended from.

rangeAgent.title: range_agent
rangeAgent.description:
A range agent (G0 M12, HR-220): marked at creation, never changed; all
 its runs are simulated and it may use only simulated connections.

pantherclaw.v1.Agent.title: Agent
pantherclaw.v1.Agent.description: Agent is one accountable agent record.

pantherclaw.v1.AgentChange.title: AgentChange
pantherclaw.v1.AgentChange.description: AgentChange is one entry of an agent's history (F024).

nextAction.title: next_action
nextAction.description:
The next action this state requires (F020), for example "admit an
 instance".

highestAttestationLevel.title: highest_attestation_level
highestAttestationLevel.description: Highest attestation level among admitted instances (0 when none).

lastVerifyTime.title: last_verify_time
lastVerifyTime.description: Last successful verification of any instance.

instancesNeedingReview.title: instances_needing_review
instancesNeedingReview.description: Instances flagged for review after drift (F033).

discovery.title: discovery
discovery.description: The discovery, for discovered (or merged) agents.

pantherclaw.v1.AgentSummary.title: AgentSummary
pantherclaw.v1.AgentSummary.description:
AgentSummary answers who owns the agent, what it is for, where it runs and
 how its identity is verified (F017, F031). Authority (M4) and protected
 paths (M9) are added by later milestones.

asNewAgent.title: as_new_agent
asNewAgent.description: Keep it as its own agent with these details.

mergeIntoAgentId.title: merge_into_agent_id
mergeIntoAgentId.description:
Merge its discovery into this existing agent (F035); the discovered
 record is retired.

agent.title: agent
agent.description: The agent that now owns the discovery.

pantherclaw.v1.ClaimAgentResponse.title: ClaimAgentResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ClaimAgentResponse.description: ClaimAgentResponse returns the claimed (or merged-into) agent.

executionContext.title: execution_context
executionContext.description: Execution context; fixed for the agent's life.

pantherclaw.v1.ClaimDetails.title: ClaimDetails
pantherclaw.v1.ClaimDetails.description: ClaimDetails are the accountable details a claimed agent needs.

executionContext.title: execution_context
executionContext.description: Execution context; fixed for the agent's life.

rangeAgent.title: range_agent
rangeAgent.description:
Creates a range agent (G0 M12, HR-220): all its runs are simulated and it
 may use only simulated connections. At most 5 per organization; they do
 not count toward the edition's agent limit. Fixed for the agent's life.

keyThumbprint.title: key_thumbprint
keyThumbprint.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the observed key (gateway discoveries).

untrustedObserved.title: untrusted_observed
untrustedObserved.description:
UNTRUSTED attributes as observed (gateway, route, client address, user
 agent). Never use them to identify the agent.

pantherclaw.v1.Discovery.title: Discovery
pantherclaw.v1.Discovery.description: Discovery is what a gateway or scan observed about a discovered agent.

pantherclaw.v1.ListAgentChangesRequest.title: ListAgentChangesRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ListAgentChangesRequest.description: ListAgentChangesRequest pages through an agent's history.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

states.title: states
states.description: Only agents in these states (all when empty).

includeAutomations.title: include_automations
includeAutomations.description:
Also list automations as execution identities (G0 M11 part 2 D15,
 F025); needs automation.read, else omitted with a note.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

orgHasNoAgents.title: org_has_no_agents
orgHasNoAgents.description:
True when the org has no agents at all, as opposed to none matching the
 filters (F624).

automations.title: automations
automations.description:
Automations, when include_automations was set and the caller holds
 automation.read (on the first page only).

automationsNote.title: automations_note
automationsNote.description: Why automations were omitted, when they were asked for.

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
Why it should be restored, shown to the deciders and recorded in the
 history.

pantherclaw.v1.RequestAgentRestorationRe.title: RequestAgentRestorationRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RequestAgentRestorationRe.description: RequestAgentRestorationRequest asks to restore a suspended agent.

approvalRequestId.title: approval_request_id
approvalRequestId.description: The RESTORATION approval request, decided at /approvals/{id}.

deadlineTime.title: deadline_time
deadlineTime.description: Without approval by then, the agent stays suspended.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
"mcp_server" or "agent_project" from a local scan; from a gateway's
 organization scan (G0 M8, HR-209), "github_app", "github_workflow" or
 "github_mcp_config".

key.title: key
key.description:
Stable key of the finding on the scanning machine (hex SHA-256), so a
 later scan of the same thing is only counted.

attributes.title: attributes
attributes.description: UNTRUSTED attributes (client, config, name, command, path, frameworks).

pantherclaw.v1.ScanFinding.title: ScanFinding
pantherclaw.v1.ScanFinding.description: ScanFinding is one finding of a local scan.

host.title: host
host.description: UNTRUSTED name of the scanned machine.

scanId.title: scan_id
scanId.description:
The organization scan the findings are from (G0 M8, HR-209). Only a
 gateway sets it, on the gateway listener, while it holds that scan's
 org_scan lease; the org comes from its certificate (HR-020).

lease.title: lease
lease.description:
The secret of the scan's org_scan lease the gateway holds, with
 scan_id: the server compares its hash, so only the holder of the lease
 submits, not any holder of the gateway's certificate.

dropped.title: dropped
dropped.description: Findings dropped because the org already has 200 open discoveries.

backupOwnerUserId.title: backup_owner_user_id
backupOwnerUserId.description: New backup owner; empty to remove it.

pantherclaw.v1.TransferOwnershipRequest.title: TransferOwnershipRequest
pantherclaw.v1.TransferOwnershipRequest.description: TransferOwnershipRequest sets the owner and backup owner.

pantherclaw.v1.UpdateAgentRequest.title: UpdateAgentRequest
pantherclaw.v1.UpdateAgentRequest.description: UpdateAgentRequest changes the fields that are set.

pantherclaw.v1.CaptureDirection.title: CaptureDirection
pantherclaw.v1.CaptureDirection.description: CaptureDirection is which body of a dispatch a payload capture holds.

pantherclaw.v1.ChecklistStatus.title: ChecklistStatus
pantherclaw.v1.ChecklistStatus.description: ChecklistStatus is the outcome of one checklist item.

pantherclaw.v1.ConsequenceState.title: ConsequenceState
pantherclaw.v1.ConsequenceState.description:
ConsequenceState is what a consequence rule said about an action
 (HR-206).

pantherclaw.v1.DispatchMode.title: DispatchMode
pantherclaw.v1.DispatchMode.description: DispatchMode is how a route treats decisions (PN-013).

pantherclaw.v1.WaitState.title: WaitState
pantherclaw.v1.WaitState.description:
WaitState is the state of a held action's approval request as a waiter
 sees it (HR-174): states, codes and times only.

workload.title: workload
workload.description:
The workload's PAP/1 credentials as the gateway received them; the
 Authority re-verifies them itself (PAP-1 §7.1, HR-021).

payloadFindings.title: payload_findings
payloadFindings.description:
Credential-shaped values the gateway found in the action's payload
 (HR-225). Each makes the Authority require a person's approval; none
 can lift a requirement. At most 16, sorted, never the value.

pantherclaw.v1.AuthorizeRequest.title: AuthorizeRequest
pantherclaw.v1.AuthorizeRequest.description:
AuthorizeRequest carries the action as canonical ActionIR JSON bytes, so
 both sides hash exactly the same bytes.

transactionId.title: transaction_id
transactionId.description: Server-minted transaction id (empty when the action could not be bound).

actionHash.title: action_hash
actionHash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical action.

permit.title: permit
permit.description: Dispatch permit JWS; only for a fresh ALLOW.

epoch.title: epoch
epoch.description: Containment epoch the permit was issued under.

nonce.title: nonce
nonce.description: The org's current PAP/1 nonce, for the PAP-Nonce response header.

checklist.title: checklist
checklist.description:
The full checklist: one item per check of the ten steps, decisive item
 first (F078, F092). Never contains agent-supplied text.

effectiveActionHash.title: effective_action_hash
effectiveActionHash.description:
Hex SHA-256 of the effective action, when an obligation clamps a
 parameter (F104, F107); empty otherwise. The gateway dispatches the
 effective action (M6).

decisionBasisDigest.title: decision_basis_digest
decisionBasisDigest.description:
Decision-basis digest ("sha256:" and 64 hex digits): the policy
 version, grant chain and guardrail revisions, definition digest and
 facts digest the decision used. Approvals bind it (HR-030).

evaluation.title: evaluation
evaluation.description:
Evaluation number of this decision for the (run, action), from 1. An
 open decision (REQUIRE_*, CANNOT_AUTHORIZE) is evaluated again on
 retry (HR-006).

repeat.title: repeat
repeat.description:
Whether this answer is a stored decision returned for a repeat
 (HR-005), not a new evaluation.

wait.title: wait
wait.description:
The wait handle of a held action (REQUIRE_APPROVAL, REQUIRE_STEP_UP),
 and the state of its approval request (PAP-1 §8, G0 M5 part 2).

mode.title: mode
mode.description:
How the action's route treats this decision (G0 M6, PN-013). In
 monitor mode the decision is hypothetical: nothing is reserved, and a
 permit is returned whatever the decision unless identity or containment
 failed (HR-184). The permit, not the decision, then says whether to
 dispatch.

accessMode.title: access_mode
accessMode.description:
Access mode of the action's connection (F416), for the gateway's
 execution record.

consequences.title: consequences
consequences.description:
What the action's consequence rules said, in rule order (G0 M8,
 HR-206): each consequence predicted, not ruled out (UNKNOWN) or ruled
 out. A predicted consequence is a prediction, never an authorized or
 confirmed effect. Empty for a stored decision (repeat).

permitId.title: permit_id
permitId.description: Permit id from the permit's jti.

outboundMethod.title: outbound_method
outboundMethod.description:
The outbound request the gateway built and is about to send (PAP-1
 §7.3): method, URL and the SHA-256 of the exact body. Empty for
 cooperative channels, where the gateway sends nothing.

pantherclaw.v1.BeginDispatchRequest.title: BeginDispatchRequest
pantherclaw.v1.BeginDispatchRequest.description: BeginDispatchRequest moves a permit to DISPATCHING.

actionToken.title: action_token
actionToken.description:
For a target-enforced connection: the single-use PAP-Action token
 (PAP-1 §10, HR-188), bound to outbound_body_sha256. Empty otherwise.

level.title: level
level.description:
The grant or guardrail level it concerns, for example "grant
 <id>@<revision>"; empty when none.

decisive.title: decisive
decisive.description: Whether this item decided the outcome.

pantherclaw.v1.ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem
pantherclaw.v1.ChecklistItem.description: ChecklistItem is one check of the decision pipeline.

ruleId.title: rule_id
ruleId.description: The rule, as the package names it.

operation.title: operation
operation.description: The consequence operation, for example github.deployment.trigger.

environments.title: environments
environments.description: The environments a predicted consequence reaches, when the rule says.

unknown.title: unknown
unknown.description: Why each fact an unknown consequence needed could not be used.

factsDigest.title: facts_digest
factsDigest.description: Digest of the facts the rule read (F080).

pantherclaw.v1.Consequence.title: Consequence
pantherclaw.v1.Consequence.description: Consequence is what one consequence rule said about an action (F405).

repository.title: repository
repository.description: The repository the token was narrowed to (owner/repo).

repositoryId.title: repository_id
repositoryId.description: GitHub's id of that repository; 0 when GitHub did not give one.

requested.title: requested
requested.description:
The permissions requested, by name: a package's credential scope, so
 with its rules for names and levels.

granted.title: granted
granted.description:
The permissions GitHub granted, by name: those requested with
 metadata: read, or, on a refused wider grant, whatever GitHub said.

expireTime.title: expire_time
expireTime.description: When the token expires, as GitHub said.

revocation.title: revocation
revocation.description: "revoked", or "revoke_failed": the token then lasts until expire_time.

grantedIncomplete.title: granted_incomplete
grantedIncomplete.description:
True when GitHub granted more permissions than granted holds: the
 ones that made the grant wider than requested are kept first, so the
 receipt never understates it (#353 review).

pantherclaw.v1.CredentialAccess.title: CredentialAccess
pantherclaw.v1.CredentialAccess.description:
CredentialAccess is what a dispatch's minted credential allowed (G0 M8,
 ADR-0021 item 5): for a GitHub App connection, the installation token's
 installation, repository and permissions as requested and as GitHub
 granted them, when it expires and whether it was revoked. It never
 carries the token.

recordsKey.title: records_key
recordsKey.description: The record scope's key; empty without one.

valuesRedacted.title: values_redacted
valuesRedacted.description: Values replaced with a redaction marker.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: Whether the answer was cut at its row or byte cap.

pantherclaw.v1.DataScopeApplied.title: DataScopeApplied
pantherclaw.v1.DataScopeApplied.description:
DataScopeApplied is what applying a read's data scope did to its answer
 (G0 M14 D20, D102): never a value, only the record key and counts.

pantherclaw.v1.GetNonceRequest.title: GetNonceRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetNonceRequest.description: GetNonceRequest asks for the current nonce.

rule.title: rule
rule.description: The policy rule that set it.

clamp.title: clamp
clamp.description:
Whether the parameter was clamped to fit (the effective action differs
 from the requested one).

maxEntropy.title: max_entropy
maxEntropy.description:
Entropy limit in bits per byte (decimal string), for disclosure_limits
 (HR-079): max is then the byte limit.

pantherclaw.v1.Obligation.title: Obligation
pantherclaw.v1.Obligation.description: Obligation is a constraint the gateway applies before dispatch.

profileId.title: profile_id
profileId.description: The capture profile it was taken under.

content.title: content
content.description: The body, truncated to the profile's cap (at most 64 KiB).

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: Whether content is cut to the cap.

pantherclaw.v1.PayloadCapture.title: PayloadCapture
pantherclaw.v1.PayloadCapture.description: PayloadCapture is one captured body of a dispatch (HR-199).

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
The format: github_token, private_key, aws_access_key, slack_token or
 pantherclaw_token; or scan_incomplete, when the gateway could not look
 at the whole payload (too many strings, a base64 value too large).

location.title: location
location.description:
Where it is, such as arg:content or body:/files/0/content(base64);
 never the value.

pantherclaw.v1.PayloadFinding.title: PayloadFinding
pantherclaw.v1.PayloadFinding.description: PayloadFinding is one credential-shaped value in an action's payload.

code.title: code
code.description:
Stable machine code, for example GRANT_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED. Holds add
 APPROVAL_DECLINED, APPROVAL_EXPIRED, NARROWER_PROPOSED,
 HOLD_LIMIT_REACHED, STEP_UP_SUBJECT_NOT_A_PERSON and
 REQUIREMENT_INVALID (G0 M5 part 2).

decisive.title: decisive
decisive.description: Whether this reason decided the outcome.

targetStatus.title: target_status
targetStatus.description: HTTP status from the target, 0 when none was received.

responseDigest.title: response_digest
responseDigest.description: SHA-256 of the target response body, empty when none was received.

targetRef.title: target_ref
targetRef.description:
The identifier of what the target created, read from a 2xx response at
 the place the definition's verifier names (G0 M7, PAP-1 §7.4); empty
 when there is none. The Authority keeps it only when it matches the
 verifier read's target pattern. It is the only part of a response body
 the gateway sends.

captures.title: captures
captures.description:
The bodies captured under an active capture profile (G0 M7 design
 decision 10, HR-199): the outbound body the gateway built and/or the
 target's response after secret-echo redaction, each truncated to the
 profile's cap; never headers. Empty unless a profile covers the
 dispatch; never sent for monitor-mode or delegated outcomes.

credentialAccess.title: credential_access
credentialAccess.description:
What the dispatch's minted credential allowed (G0 M8, ADR-0021 item 5);
 unset for a credential placed as sealed, or none.

dataScope.title: data_scope
dataScope.description:
What the gateway's data scope did to the answer (G0 M14 D102), counts
 only; unset when no data scope applied.

pantherclaw.v1.RecordExecutionRequest.title: RecordExecutionRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RecordExecutionRequest.description: RecordExecutionRequest reports what happened at the target.

workload.title: workload
workload.description: The request's credentials, as for Authorize.

runId.title: run_id
runId.description:
The run (PAP-Run-Id), never the nil UUID; the instance must be allowed
 to use it (HR-022).

connectionId.title: connection_id
connectionId.description: The connection the call came through.

tool.title: tool
tool.description: The tool's name as the agent SDK sent it (UNTRUSTED).

inputSha256.title: input_sha256
inputSha256.description: SHA-256 of the tool's input as received.

pantherclaw.v1.RecordToolObservationRequ.title: RecordToolObservationRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RecordToolObservationRequ.description:
RecordToolObservationRequest is one tool call an agent SDK runs without a
 mapping.

verified.title: verified
verified.description: Whether the credentials verified and the observation was recorded.

errorCode.title: error_code
errorCode.description:
When not verified: the PAP-Error code, `agent_unusable`, or
 `connection_not_served` (the connection is not one this gateway serves).

nonce.title: nonce
nonce.description: Current nonce, for the PAP-Nonce response header.

pantherclaw.v1.RecordToolObservationResp.title: RecordToolObservationResponse
pantherclaw.v1.RecordToolObservationResp.description:
RecordToolObservationResponse says whether the workload verified and the
 observation was recorded.

workload.title: workload
workload.description: The request's key-only PAP/1 credentials (no workload token).

userAgent.title: user_agent
userAgent.description: UNTRUSTED user agent, truncated by the gateway.

route.title: route
route.description: Route the request was addressed to.

discoveryId.title: discovery_id
discoveryId.description:
Discovery id; empty when the sighting was only counted (rate or cap
 reached).

nonce.title: nonce
nonce.description: Current nonce, for the PAP-Nonce response header.

workload.title: workload
workload.description: The request's credentials, as for Authorize.

runId.title: run_id
runId.description:
Optional run (PAP-Run-Id) the request is made in: the instance must be
 allowed to use it, as for an action (HR-022), and the response says
 when it expires. An MCP session lives on a run.

pantherclaw.v1.VerifyWorkloadRequest.title: VerifyWorkloadRequest
pantherclaw.v1.VerifyWorkloadRequest.description: VerifyWorkloadRequest carries a request's PAP/1 credentials.

verified.title: verified
verified.description: Whether the credentials verified and the agent is usable.

errorCode.title: error_code
errorCode.description:
When not verified: the PAP-Error code (PAP-1 §12, `run_mismatch` for a
 run the instance may not use), or `agent_unusable` for a suspended or
 retired agent.

instanceId.title: instance_id
instanceId.description: The verified instance and its environment.

nonce.title: nonce
nonce.description: Current nonce, for the PAP-Nonce response header.

jkt.title: jkt
jkt.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the key that signed the request.

runExpiresAt.title: run_expires_at
runExpiresAt.description: When the requested run expires; unset when no run was named.

pantherclaw.v1.VerifyWorkloadResponse.title: VerifyWorkloadResponse
pantherclaw.v1.VerifyWorkloadResponse.description:
VerifyWorkloadResponse says whether the workload is an admitted instance
 of a usable agent.

retryAfterSeconds.title: retry_after_seconds
retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before waiting again or resubmitting.

approvalRequestId.title: approval_request_id
approvalRequestId.description: The approval request, for the link people open (/approvals/{id}).

code.title: code
code.description:
A stable code: why the request ended (APPROVAL_DECLINED,
 APPROVAL_EXPIRED, NARROWER_PROPOSED, BINDING_CHANGED, GRANT_REVOKED, …),
 or the evidence question (EVIDENCE_REQUESTED). Never a decider's note.

evidenceDeadlineTime.title: evidence_deadline_time
evidenceDeadlineTime.description: EVIDENCE_REQUESTED: when the evidence is due.

pantherclaw.v1.WaitInfo.title: WaitInfo
pantherclaw.v1.WaitInfo.description:
WaitInfo is a wait handle (PAP-1 §7.1, §8). The handle is the
 transaction id (design decision 15): not a secret, because waiting needs
 PAP/1 authentication as the transaction's run and instance. Waiting never
 extends a deadline or dispatches anything (HR-174).

workloadToken.title: workload_token
workloadToken.description:
Workload token from "Authorization: PAP <token>"; empty for a key-only
 proof.

bodySha256.title: body_sha256
bodySha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw request body, computed before any parsing.

htm.title: htm
htm.description: HTTP method of the workload's request.

htu.title: htu
htu.description:
Target URI of the workload's request (scheme, host, path), from the
 gateway's configured public URL, never from the Host header.

clientAddress.title: client_address
clientAddress.description: UNTRUSTED client address as the gateway saw it (HR-092 network alert).

pantherclaw.v1.WorkloadCredentials.title: WorkloadCredentials
pantherclaw.v1.WorkloadCredentials.description:
WorkloadCredentials are a workload's PAP/1 request credentials as the
 gateway received them (PAP-1 §4). The gateway hashes the raw body before
 parsing it; the Authority verifies everything again.

pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalState.title: ApprovalState
pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalState.description:
ApprovalState is a request's state (HR-171). PENDING and
 EVIDENCE_REQUESTED wait for deciders; APPROVED waits for the agent to
 resubmit; the others are final.

pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalSubjectKind.title: ApprovalSubjectKind
pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalSubjectKind.description: ApprovalSubjectKind is what a request decides.

pantherclaw.v1.DeciderResponseKind.title: DeciderResponseKind
pantherclaw.v1.DeciderResponseKind.description: DeciderResponseKind is the kind of a decider's response.

pantherclaw.v1.DeclineReason.title: DeclineReason
pantherclaw.v1.DeclineReason.description: DeclineReason is why a decider declined (design decision 11).

pantherclaw.v1.EvidenceQuestion.title: EvidenceQuestion
pantherclaw.v1.EvidenceQuestion.description: EvidenceQuestion is what a decider asks the run for.

pantherclaw.v1.SaferAlternative.title: SaferAlternative
pantherclaw.v1.SaferAlternative.description: SaferAlternative is an optional pointer a decider gives with a decline.

canApprove.title: can_approve
canApprove.description: Whether the caller may approve (or step up) now.

canRespond.title: can_respond
canRespond.description: Whether the caller may decline, ask for evidence or propose.

requirements.title: requirements
requirements.description: Requirements the caller's response would count toward (indexes).

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
Why not, as a stable code (for example LAUNCHER_EXCLUDED,
 ROLE_COOLDOWN, NO_ACTIVE_CREDENTIAL, ALREADY_RESPONDED).

eligibleFrom.title: eligible_from
eligibleFrom.description:
When the caller's own approver cooldowns end (account age, role
 binding age and security key age, whichever ends last): from then on
 their response would count toward a requirement if nothing else
 changes. Unset when it already counts toward one, and when waiting
 alone never makes it count (an exclusion, no approval role, no active
 security key). Only ever the caller's own (D81).

pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalEligibility.title: ApprovalEligibility
pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalEligibility.description: ApprovalEligibility says whether the caller may decide a request now.

note.title: note
note.description: UNTRUSTED text, with bidi and control characters removed.

mixedScript.title: mixed_script
mixedScript.description: Whether the text mixes scripts in one word (HR-034).

pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalEvidence.title: ApprovalEvidence
pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalEvidence.description:
ApprovalEvidence is one UNTRUSTED note from the run (HR-172): shown only
 in the untrusted block, never in notifications, never part of the binding.

endReason.title: end_reason
endReason.description:
Why a final request ended (for example APPROVAL_DECLINED,
 GRANT_REVOKED, BINDING_CHANGED).

runId.title: run_id
runId.description: ACTION: the run, the transaction and the grant revision it binds.

transactionId.title: transaction_id
transactionId.description: ACTION: the held transaction (the wait handle).

deadlineTime.title: deadline_time
deadlineTime.description: Deadline; without approval by then the action ends as DENY.

consumeByTime.title: consume_by_time
consumeByTime.description: The agent must resubmit before this time.

simulated.title: simulated
simulated.description:
Whether the held action is a range run's (G0 M12, HR-222): a console
 shows a SIMULATED banner. Approvals stay humans-only.

role.title: role
role.description: Approval: the default role whose approval.respond counts (decision 2).

independent.title: independent
independent.description:
Approval: the agent's owners and the grant's issuer are excluded too
 (decision 3).

sources.title: sources
sources.description: Where the requirement comes from: grant levels and policy rules.

satisfied.title: satisfied
satisfied.description: Responses that currently count toward it.

pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalRequirement.title: ApprovalRequirement
pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalRequirement.description:
ApprovalRequirement is one merged requirement of a request with its
 sources (design decisions 1 and 14).

pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalVariant.title: ApprovalVariant
pantherclaw.v1.ApprovalVariant.description:
ApprovalVariant is an earlier request for the same grant, operation and
 target (HR-037).

requirement.title: requirement
requirement.description: APPROVE and STEP_UP: the requirement it counts toward (index).

note.title: note
note.description:
The decider's note, for people only: never returned to workloads,
 never sent in a notification and never logged.

credentialId.title: credential_id
credentialId.description: APPROVE and STEP_UP: the WebAuthn credential used.

batchId.title: batch_id
batchId.description: The batch it was part of, if any.

voidTime.title: void_time
voidTime.description: Set when the response stopped counting (HR-170).

voidReason.title: void_reason
voidReason.description:
ROLE_REMOVED, USER_DISABLED, CREDENTIAL_REMOVED, CREDENTIAL_SUSPENDED
 or NOT_ELIGIBLE.

note.title: note
note.description: A note for people (at most 500 characters).

pantherclaw.v1.DeclineApprovalBatchReque.title: DeclineApprovalBatchRequest
pantherclaw.v1.DeclineApprovalBatchReque.description: DeclineApprovalBatchRequest declines several requests for one operation.

pantherclaw.v1.DeclineApprovalBatchRespo.title: DeclineApprovalBatchResponse
pantherclaw.v1.DeclineApprovalBatchRespo.description: DeclineApprovalBatchResponse returns the batch and its requests.

note.title: note
note.description: A note for people (at most 500 characters).

display.title: display
display.description:
The stored display (canonical JSON, HR-034): exactly what the binding
 covers. Its untrusted block holds agent-supplied text.

displayHash.title: display_hash
displayHash.description: SHA-256 of display, base64url (the binding's display_hash).

variants.title: variants
variants.description: Earlier variants of this grant, operation and target.

states.title: states
states.description:
Only requests in these states (PENDING and EVIDENCE_REQUESTED when
 empty).

waitingForMe.title: waiting_for_me
waitingForMe.description: Only requests the caller may decide now.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

checkedScopes.title: checked_scopes
checkedScopes.description:
The scopes whose requests the caller can see, so that an empty list
 means "nothing waiting there" (F626).

params.title: params
params.description:
The proposed material parameters as a JSON object in the definition's
 canonical form. Only material parameters may change, and only toward
 narrower values: amounts and integers no larger in magnitude, lists as
 subsets (HR-172).

note.title: note
note.description: A note for people (at most 500 characters).

validateOnly.title: validate_only
validateOnly.description:
Simulate only: check the proposal and return its decision without
 ending the request.

request.title: request
request.description: The request (DECLINED with NARROWER_PROPOSED unless validate_only).

simulatedDecision.title: simulated_decision
simulatedDecision.description: The pipeline's decision for the proposal, as the agent would get it.

note.title: note
note.description: A note for people (at most 500 characters).

evidenceDeadlineTime.title: evidence_deadline_time
evidenceDeadlineTime.description: When the evidence is due; before the request's deadline.

pantherclaw.v1.RequestApprovalEvidenceRe.title: RequestApprovalEvidenceRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RequestApprovalEvidenceRe.description: RequestApprovalEvidenceRequest asks the run for evidence.

request.title: request
request.description: The request (back to PENDING when evidence was requested).

pantherclaw.v1.SubmitApprovalEvidenceRes.title: SubmitApprovalEvidenceResponse
pantherclaw.v1.SubmitApprovalEvidenceRes.description: SubmitApprovalEvidenceResponse returns the evidence and the request.

name.title: name
name.description: grants, runs or a currency code.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationBudget.title: AutomationBudget
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationBudget.description: AutomationBudget is one ceiling budget for today (UTC).

state.title: state
state.description: The simulated execution's final state and reason.

steps.title: steps
steps.description: Final state per step, and what differed from the expectation.

duplicateRefused.title: duplicate_refused
duplicateRefused.description: DUPLICATE: the second submission was refused as a duplicate.

missingContext.title: missing_context
missingContext.description:
missing_context names what could not be evaluated, with counts
 ("CONDITION_PROBE:coverage.below=12").

samplesHidden.title: samples_hidden
samplesHidden.description:
samples_hidden counts samples left out because they involve an agent
 outside the caller's exposure.read scope.

launchPreview.title: launch_preview
launchPreview.description:
Each launch_run step's dry-run issuance against the authority row
 (or the version's ceiling), as "step=ALLOWED" or
 "step=REFUSED:<reason>".

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Why hidden samples are hidden ("involves more than 64 agents").

state.title: state
state.description: RUNNING, WAITING, DONE, FAILED, SKIPPED or UNKNOWN.

effect.title: effect
effect.description: CHANGED, UNCHANGED, UNKNOWN or NONE (default NONE).

evidence.title: evidence
evidence.description:
evidence: the result carries completion evidence (a finish condition
 on this step can be met).

wait.title: wait
wait.description: wait: a WAITING result wakes after this long (default 15 s).

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationStubResult.title: AutomationStubResult
pantherclaw.v1.AutomationStubResult.description: AutomationStubResult is what one attempt of a stubbed step returns.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: NORMAL, DENIED, TIMEOUT, DUPLICATE, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN or CUSTOM.

params.title: params
params.description: The trigger's parameters, as text, converted by their declarations.

steps.title: steps
steps.description: Expected final state of named steps (step id -> state).

narrowedCeiling.title: narrowed_ceiling
narrowedCeiling.description:
The narrowed ceiling: the version's `authority.ceiling` document as
 JSON.

failingExecutionIds.title: failing_execution_ids
failingExecutionIds.description:
Executions in the last 30 days whose grants the narrowed ceiling would
 not have allowed.

automationId.title: automation_id
automationId.description: automation_id: one automation, or empty for all the caller may read.

nextRunTime.title: next_run_time
nextRunTime.description: next_run_time is the next schedule occurrence, when scheduled.

latestExecutionId.title: latest_execution_id
latestExecutionId.description:
The latest execution to end, and whether its completion evidence
 exists (a SUCCEEDED execution without it is not a verified outcome).

stage.title: stage
stage.description: stage: SHADOW, COHORT, FULL, or empty when not enabled.

executions.title: executions
executions.description: Executions of the enabled version by mode and state ("LIVE:SUCCEEDED").

shadowedEffects.title: shadowed_effects
shadowedEffects.description: shadowed_effects counts effectful steps recorded SHADOWED.

wouldBeRefusals.title: would_be_refusals
wouldBeRefusals.description:
would_be_refusals counts shadowed steps whose would-be decision was a
 refusal, by reason.

fullVerified.title: full_verified
fullVerified.description: full_verified: COHORT may widen to FULL; else the reasons it may not.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: notes: what could not be read (a connection without a package).

approvals.title: approvals
approvals.description: Approvals the ceiling's requirements and the policy hold for it.

verification.title: verification
verification.description: How the effect is verified: VERIFIER, RECONCILIATION or NONE.

pantherclaw.v1.InspectedOperation.title: InspectedOperation
pantherclaw.v1.InspectedOperation.description: InspectedOperation is one operation a consequential step may perform.

scopes.title: scopes
scopes.description: Platform scopes the step may touch.

approvals.title: approvals
approvals.description: Approvals every issued grant carries (the ceiling's requirements).

restrictions.title: restrictions
restrictions.description: Restrictions the ceiling cannot override (published policy rules).

uncoveredRoutes.title: uncovered_routes
uncoveredRoutes.description: Routes without an enforced decision (coverage UNKNOWN).

uncertainSideEffects.title: uncertain_side_effects
uncertainSideEffects.description: Operations whose side effects are not verified.

triggeredAutomationIds.title: triggered_automation_ids
triggeredAutomationIds.description: Other automations whose triggers match events this version produces.

restricted.title: restricted
restricted.description: restricted: agents outside the caller's exposure.read were left out.

versionState.title: version_state
versionState.description:
version_state is the version's state after the run (TESTED when it
 passed).

missingKinds.title: missing_kinds
missingKinds.description: missing_kinds are the required kinds no case covers yet.

otherAgentIds.title: other_agent_ids
otherAgentIds.description: Other agents whose reach goes through the same connection.

pantherclaw.v1.SimulationDay.title: SimulationDay
pantherclaw.v1.SimulationDay.description: SimulationDay is one day's would-be triggers.

budget.title: budget
budget.description: Budget per currency: the ceiling's maximum and the expected spend.

pantherclaw.v1.SimulationForecast.title: SimulationForecast
pantherclaw.v1.SimulationForecast.description: SimulationForecast is per-day expectations from the history.

steps.title: steps
steps.description:
Per step: id, kind and the would-be decision (ALLOWED, REFUSED with a
 reason, SKIPPED, UNEVALUABLE).

agentIds.title: agent_ids
agentIds.description:
The agents the sample involves (its trigger's and its launch_run
 steps'); shown only when every one is in the caller's exposure.read
 scope.

pantherclaw.v1.SimulationSample.title: SimulationSample
pantherclaw.v1.SimulationSample.description: SimulationSample is one would-be execution with its prospective steps.

status.title: status
status.description:
OK, DENIED, HELD, FAILED, UNKNOWN, or SKIPPED for each declared call
 after the runner stopped.

pantherclaw.v1.AutomationCallResult.title: AutomationCallResult

cardKeys.title: card_keys
