Optional pinned JWKS: when the card carries signatures, one must
 verify with a key from it.

skills.title: skills
skills.description: Skill ids agents may use, a subset of the card's.

peerAgentId.title: peer_agent_id
peerAgentId.description:
An enrolled agent of this org that the peer endpoint belongs to; its
 runs for requests through this connection are delegated (D33).

peerScope.title: peer_scope
peerScope.description:
The bounds and limits the peer may use for requests from this route;
 required with peer_agent_id.

maxAnswerBytes.title: max_answer_bytes
maxAnswerBytes.description: Answer cap in bytes (default 1 MiB, at most 8 MiB).

maxStreamSeconds.title: max_stream_seconds
maxStreamSeconds.description:
Longest a relayed stream may run, in seconds (default 300, at most
 3600).

pantherclaw.v1.A2AConfig.title: A2AConfig
pantherclaw.v1.A2AConfig.description:
A2AConfig is an a2a connection (G0 M14 D30): the peer agent's pinned
 agent card and the interface the gateway calls. Creating it and
 refreshing the pin need a step-up; a card whose digest changes is drift
 and quarantines the connection until it is pinned again (HR-322).

pantherclaw.v1.A2AInterface.title: A2AInterface
pantherclaw.v1.A2AInterface.description: A2AInterface is one interface of an agent card.

limits.title: limits
limits.description: Limits (grant limits v1, JSON); empty for none.

pantherclaw.v1.A2APeerScope.title: A2APeerScope
pantherclaw.v1.A2APeerScope.description: A2APeerScope bounds what a peer agent may do for a requester (D33).

pantherclaw.v1.CapabilitySupport.title: CapabilitySupport
pantherclaw.v1.CapabilitySupport.description: CapabilitySupport is one capability's level and why.

name.title: name
name.description: Name, unique among live connections; agents use it in gateway paths.

package.title: package
package.description: Tool package; the org's pinned version applies.

baseUrl.title: base_url
baseUrl.description: Base URL (scheme, host and port), empty for local connections.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts a credential may be sent to.

credentialHeader.title: credential_header
credentialHeader.description: Header a credential goes in, and its optional scheme.

defaultMode.title: default_mode
defaultMode.description: Mode of routes without an explicit mode.

quarantineReason.title: quarantine_reason
quarantineReason.description: Why it is quarantined (a reason code).

revision.title: revision
revision.description: Revision; UpdateConnection must name the current one.

updatedBy.title: updated_by
updatedBy.description: Who changed it last and when.

agentHosts.title: agent_hosts
agentHosts.description:
agent_hosts are the host names agents use for this connection's API
 (G0 M9): a containment sandbox's edge maps each to it (HR-183).

connector.title: connector
connector.description: connector is an mcp_container connection's current spec.

github.title: github
github.description:
The GitHub App installation behind a connection holding a GitHub App
 credential (G0 M8, ADR-0021); unset otherwise.

simulated.title: simulated
simulated.description:
Whether the connection is simulated (G0 M12, HR-221): it points only at a
 simulator, and only range agents' runs may use it.

postgres.title: postgres
postgres.description: postgres is a postgres connection's configuration and manifest.

a2a.title: a2a
a2a.description: a2a is an a2a connection's configuration and pinned card.

discovery.title: discovery
discovery.description: Discovery: unknown workloads and, for MCP, upstream tools.

enforcement.title: enforcement
enforcement.description: Enforcement: whether a decision stops the call.

response.title: response
response.description: Response: quarantine, the kill switch, credential revocation.

responseActions.title: response_actions
responseActions.description:
The response controls that apply: quarantine, kill_switch,
 revoke_credential, rotate_credential.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description:
What PantherClaw's credential for it is used for; empty when it holds
 none.

failureBehavior.title: failure_behavior
failureBehavior.description: How it behaves when something fails, one statement each.

lastPassedTest.title: last_passed_test
lastPassedTest.description: Its last successful test (F350); unset when it never passed one.

open.title: open
open.description: Whether it is open (the connection is then quarantined).

unknownCount.title: unknown_count
unknownCount.description: UNKNOWN outcomes and all outcomes in the window the gateway reported.

openTime.title: open_time
openTime.description: When it opened; unset when closed.

reportTime.title: report_time
reportTime.description: When the gateway reported it last.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionCircuit.title: ConnectionCircuit
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionCircuit.description: ConnectionCircuit is one gateway's circuit for a connection (HR-078).

brokerKeyId.title: broker_key_id
brokerKeyId.description: Broker key it was sealed to, and that key's fingerprint.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts it may be sent to.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
Kind: "static" (placed as sealed) or "github_app" (an App key from
 which the gateway mints an installation token per action, G0 M8).

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionCredential.title: ConnectionCredential
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionCredential.description:
ConnectionCredential is a credential version's metadata; the sealed bytes are never
 returned.

sinceTime.title: since_time
sinceTime.description: The start of the window (24 hours before the read).

lastFailureTime.title: last_failure_time
lastFailureTime.description: The latest failed or UNKNOWN outcome; unset when none.

lastSuccessTime.title: last_success_time
lastSuccessTime.description: The latest accepted outcome; unset when none.

delegatedCount.title: delegated_count
delegatedCount.description:
Actions an agent ran itself after the decision (delegated): PantherClaw
 never learns their result, so they count neither as failures nor as
 successes (HR-024).

lastDelegatedTime.title: last_delegated_time
lastDelegatedTime.description: The latest delegated outcome; unset when none.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionDeliveries.title: ConnectionDeliveries
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionDeliveries.description:
ConnectionDeliveries are the outcomes recorded for a connection's actions
 since a time.

lastUseTime.title: last_use_time
lastUseTime.description: When it last used the connection.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionDependentAgent.title: ConnectionDependentAgent
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionDependentAgent.description: ConnectionDependentAgent is an agent whose runs used a connection.

activeCredential.title: active_credential
activeCredential.description: Its active credential's metadata; unset when none.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: What PantherClaw's credential for it is used for.

lastTest.title: last_test
lastTest.description:
Its latest test, of any kind: a credential test checks only the
 configuration and never reaches the target, so read its kind.

lastPassedTest.title: last_passed_test
lastPassedTest.description: Its last successful test, of any kind (see last_test).

deliveries.title: deliveries
deliveries.description: Delivery failures over the last 24 hours.

dependentAgents.title: dependent_agents
dependentAgents.description: Agents that used it over the last 30 days, latest first, at most 50.

dependentAgentsHidden.title: dependent_agents_hidden
dependentAgentsHidden.description: The caller may not read agents org-wide, so neither list is shown.

grantedAgents.title: granted_agents
grantedAgents.description:
Agents whose active grants allow an operation the connection serves,
 so they depend on it, by name, at most 50. last_use_time is unset.

code.title: code
code.description: A stable code, for example OPERATION_NOT_SERVED.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionLimit.title: ConnectionLimit
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionLimit.description: ConnectionLimit is something the connection does not do (F350).

access.title: access
access.description: The definition's access: read or write.

verified.title: verified
verified.description:
Whether the definition declares a verifier, so the effect can be
 observed after dispatch (M7).

mode.title: mode
mode.description: The route's mode on the connection.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionOperation.title: ConnectionOperation
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionOperation.description: ConnectionOperation is one operation a connection serves (F348).

name.title: name
name.description:
The permission: a credential scope the definition declares
 (`name:level`), or without one `<access> <target type>`.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionPermission.title: ConnectionPermission
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionPermission.description:
ConnectionPermission is something the connection's credential is used
 for, with the operations that need it (F349).

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionRoute.title: ConnectionRoute
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionRoute.description: ConnectionRoute is one route's explicit mode.

result.title: result
result.description: Result, once the test is done.

finishTime.title: finish_time
finishTime.description: When it finished; unset while it runs.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
credential (checks what the connection depends on, without calling
 the target), read (a harmless read through the gateway) or
 target_verifier (the target refuses calls without a valid token).

state.title: state
state.description: PENDING, RUNNING, DONE (with a result) or FAILED (could not run).

operation.title: operation
operation.description:
The operation a read or target_verifier test reached; empty for a
 credential test (N23: M9 lifts the cooperative cap only for the
 operation a passing target_verifier test reached).

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionTest.title: ConnectionTest
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionTest.description: ConnectionTest is one test of a connection.

check.title: check
check.description:
CONNECTION_ACTIVE, GATEWAY_ACTIVE, GATEWAY_CERTIFICATE, PACKAGE_ROUTES,
 CREDENTIAL or CIRCUIT_CLOSED.

pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionTestCheck.title: ConnectionTestCheck
pantherclaw.v1.ConnectionTestCheck.description: ConnectionTestCheck is one check of a connection test.

package.title: package
package.description: Tool package name; the org must have pinned a version of it.

baseUrl.title: base_url
baseUrl.description:
Base URL: https://host[:port], or http:// for a private address the
 gateway's operator allows. Empty for local connections.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts a credential may be sent to (default: the base URL's host).

credentialHeader.title: credential_header
credentialHeader.description: Header a credential goes in (for pantherclaw_held).

credentialScheme.title: credential_scheme
credentialScheme.description: Scheme before the credential, for example "Bearer".

defaultMode.title: default_mode
defaultMode.description: Mode of routes without an explicit mode (default monitor).

maxResponseBytes.title: max_response_bytes
maxResponseBytes.description: Response cap in bytes (default 1 MiB, at most 8 MiB).

timeoutMs.title: timeout_ms
timeoutMs.description: Dispatch timeout in milliseconds (default 10,000, at most 60,000).

agentHosts.title: agent_hosts
agentHosts.description:
agent_hosts are the host names agents use for the API; only for http
 and mcp connections.

connector.title: connector
connector.description: connector is required for, and only for, an mcp_container connection.

simulated.title: simulated
simulated.description:
Creates a simulated connection (G0 M12, HR-221): http and mcp need an IP
 literal on loopback or a private network as the base URL; mcp_container
 is refused. Fixed for the connection's life.

postgres.title: postgres
postgres.description: postgres is required for, and only for, a postgres connection.

a2a.title: a2a
a2a.description: a2a is required for, and only for, an a2a connection.

version.title: version
version.description: The version the new credential gets.

publicKey.title: public_key
publicKey.description: Seal public key: X-Wing, or MLKEM768-P256 from a FIPS gateway.

fingerprint.title: fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Its fingerprint, to show before sealing.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts the credential will be bound to.

header.title: header
header.description: Header and scheme it will be placed with.

pantherclaw.v1.GetSealingKeyResponse.title: GetSealingKeyResponse
pantherclaw.v1.GetSealingKeyResponse.description: GetSealingKeyResponse is everything a seal binds (HR-060, HR-182).

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty at the end.

pantherclaw.v1.ListCredentialsResponse.title: ListCredentialsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ListCredentialsResponse.description: ListCredentialsResponse lists its credentials, newest first.

type.title: type
type.description: Type: text, int, bigint, numeric, bool, date, timestamptz or uuid.

class.title: class
class.description: Data class: public, internal, pii or secret.

pantherclaw.v1.PostgresColumn.title: PostgresColumn
pantherclaw.v1.PostgresColumn.description: PostgresColumn is one column of a manifest table.

user.title: user
user.description: Role the gateway logs in as.

sslmode.title: sslmode
sslmode.description:
"verify-full" (required), or "require" only with internal and a pinned
 CA.

internal.title: internal
internal.description: Allows a private address; set only with a step-up.

maxRows.title: max_rows
maxRows.description: Row cap per query (default 200, at most 1000).

statementTimeoutMs.title: statement_timeout_ms
statementTimeoutMs.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds (default 5000, at most 30000).

maxResultBytes.title: max_result_bytes
maxResultBytes.description: Answer cap in bytes (default 1 MiB, at most 4 MiB).

minGroupSize.title: min_group_size
minGroupSize.description: Smallest group an aggregate returns (default 5, at least 2).

pantherclaw.v1.PostgresConfig.title: PostgresConfig
pantherclaw.v1.PostgresConfig.description:
PostgresConfig is a postgres connection (G0 M14 D15): where the database
 is and the reviewed manifest of what the gateway may read. Its password
 is the connection's sealed static credential. Identifiers are lower-case
 and never quoted. A widening change of the manifest (a new table or
 column, a class lowered, a limit raised) needs a step-up.

scopeKey.title: scope_key
scopeKey.description: The record scope key this table answers to (D20); empty for none.

scopeColumn.title: scope_column
scopeColumn.description: The column a record scope filters on; set together with scope_key.

maxRows.title: max_rows
maxRows.description: Row cap for this table; zero takes the connection's.

pantherclaw.v1.PostgresTable.title: PostgresTable
pantherclaw.v1.PostgresTable.description: PostgresTable is one table of a postgres manifest.

brokerKeyId.title: broker_key_id
brokerKeyId.description: Broker key id it was sealed to.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description:
The hosts, header and scheme the seal bound; they must equal the
 connection's current values, or the upload is refused.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
Kind the seal bound: "static" (the default when empty) or "github_app"
 (G0 M8 decision 3), which needs the header Authorization and the
 scheme Bearer.

github.title: github
github.description:
Required for a github_app credential, refused for a static one: the
 installation it was sealed for, recorded as the connection's. The
 gateway refuses a seal that holds another.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why (stored and shown as untrusted text).

pantherclaw.v1.TestConnectionRequest.title: TestConnectionRequest
pantherclaw.v1.TestConnectionRequest.description: TestConnectionRequest names a connection and the kind of test.

revision.title: revision
revision.description: The revision the caller read; a stale revision is refused.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: New credential hosts (replaces the list when update_allowed_hosts).

updateAllowedHosts.title: update_allowed_hosts
updateAllowedHosts.description: Whether allowed_hosts is set (an empty list is meaningful).

agentHosts.title: agent_hosts
agentHosts.description:
agent_hosts replaces the agent hosts when update_agent_hosts; any
 change weakens enforcement (HR-183).

connector.title: connector
connector.description:
connector replaces an mcp_container connection's spec (weakens; moving
 one to another gateway needs it).

postgres.title: postgres
postgres.description:
postgres replaces a postgres connection's configuration (a widening
 manifest change weakens).

a2a.title: a2a
a2a.description:
a2a replaces an a2a connection's configuration, or pins its card again
 (weakens).

pantherclaw.v1.UpdateConnectionRequest.title: UpdateConnectionRequest
pantherclaw.v1.UpdateConnectionRequest.description: UpdateConnectionRequest changes the fields that are set.

pantherclaw.v1.GetKillSwitchRequest.title: GetKillSwitchRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetKillSwitchRequest.description: GetKillSwitchRequest asks for the org's kill switch.

engagedBy.title: engaged_by
engagedBy.description: Who engaged it, when and why (UNTRUSTED text).

pendingRestore.title: pending_restore
pendingRestore.description: The pending restore proposal, if any.

pageUrl.title: page_url
pageUrl.description: The emergency-stop page, where it is engaged and restored.

pantherclaw.v1.KillSwitchRestore.title: KillSwitchRestore
pantherclaw.v1.KillSwitchRestore.description: KillSwitchRestore is a proposal to restore after the kill switch.

pantherclaw.v1.AccessControlMode.title: AccessControlMode
pantherclaw.v1.AccessControlMode.description:
AccessControlMode is how an actor's target access is controlled (§39.2).
 Several may apply at once.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRouteKind.title: CoverageRouteKind
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRouteKind.description: CoverageRouteKind is a way to produce a connection's effects (§41.4).

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRouteStatus.title: CoverageRouteStatus
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRouteStatus.description: CoverageRouteStatus is what the evidence says about one route.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageState.title: CoverageState
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageState.description: CoverageState is the protection claim of one scope (F435–F438).

modes.title: modes
modes.description: The modes that apply, strongest control first.

custodian.title: custodian
custodian.description: Who holds usable target authority: "gateway", "agent" or "target".

gatewayId.title: gateway_id
gatewayId.description: The gateway that holds the sealed credential, when PantherClaw holds it.

credentialVersion.title: credential_version
credentialVersion.description:
The active sealed credential's version and the hosts it may reach;
 never its value.

closureId.title: closure_id
closureId.description: The closure that confines the agent, and when it expires.

residualRoutes.title: residual_routes
residualRoutes.description: Routes of the agent's scopes on this connection that are not closed.

disclosures.title: disclosures
disclosures.description: What each mode must disclose, in plain language.

scope.title: scope
scope.description:
What the access reaches: the sealed credential's hosts, or the single
 action a token names.

audience.title: audience
audience.description: Who accepts it: the target hosts.

expiry.title: expiry
expiry.description: How long it lasts, in plain language.

agentIds.title: agent_ids
agentIds.description: The agents with coverage on the connection that the caller may read.

verifiedOperations.title: verified_operations

pantherclaw.v1.AccessDetail.title: AccessDetail
pantherclaw.v1.AccessDetail.description: AccessDetail is the access detail of a connection (and agent).

pantherclaw.v1.AcknowledgeFindingRequest.title: AcknowledgeFindingRequest
pantherclaw.v1.AcknowledgeFindingRequest.description: AcknowledgeFindingRequest names a finding and why it is dismissed.

sandboxSessionId.title: sandbox_session_id
sandboxSessionId.description: The sandbox session that produced it.

passed.title: passed
passed.description:
Whether the evidence is sound: every result and configuration check
 passed, with the named controls and the canary (PASSED). What it
 proves is closed_kinds.

closedKinds.title: closed_kinds
closedKinds.description: The route kinds it proves blocked.

signingKeyJkt.title: signing_key_jkt
signingKeyJkt.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the per-session key that signed the results.

resultsDigest.title: results_digest
resultsDigest.description: "sha256:" and the hex digest of the signed results.

engineVersion.title: engine_version
engineVersion.description: Docker engine version, API version and runtime ("runc" or "runsc").

gatewayId.title: gateway_id
gatewayId.description:
The gateway, connection revision, package version and credential
 version its session opened under.

observeTime.title: observe_time
observeTime.description: When the probes ran, when it expires and when it was recorded.

configChecks.title: config_checks
configChecks.description: pclaw's checks of the agent container.

credentialVersion.title: credential_version
credentialVersion.description:
The active sealed credential's version; absent when the connection
 had none.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageClosure.title: CoverageClosure
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageClosure.description:
CoverageClosure is the closure evidence of one sandbox session for one
 agent and connection (F457, PN-008.2).

detail.title: detail
detail.description: Detail, at most 512 characters. UNTRUSTED, like a probe's.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageConfigCheck.title: CoverageConfigCheck
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageConfigCheck.description: CoverageConfigCheck is one of pclaw's checks of the agent container.

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: Agent; empty for every agent of the connection.

routeKind.title: route_kind
routeKind.description: Route kind; unspecified for the whole scope.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why, in the creator's words (untrusted text).

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageExclusion.title: CoverageExclusion
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageExclusion.description: CoverageExclusion excludes a scope or a route kind from a claim.

connectionId.title: connection_id
connectionId.description: Connection, when the finding is about one.

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: Agent, when the finding is about one.

subject.title: subject
subject.description:
What holds the reach, e.g. "GitHub App pantherclaw-ci"; untrusted
 text.

declared.title: declared
declared.description: Permissions ("name:level") the operations declare they need.

used.title: used
used.description: Permissions the operations the gateway carried need.

excess.title: excess
excess.description: Permissions held beyond the declared need.

firstSeenTime.title: first_seen_time
firstSeenTime.description: First and last seen, resolved or dismissed.

dismissedBy.title: dismissed_by
dismissedBy.description: The person who dismissed it and why (untrusted text).

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageFinding.title: CoverageFinding
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageFinding.description: CoverageFinding is an exposure finding (F048; M10 adds kinds).

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: The agent it affects; empty for every agent of the connection.

reassessTime.title: reassess_time
reassessTime.description: When the reassess job handled it; unset while pending.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageInvalidation.title: CoverageInvalidation
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageInvalidation.description: CoverageInvalidation is a change that drops ENFORCED at once (HR-211).

expireTime.title: expire_time
expireTime.description: When it expired or would have.

lapseReason.title: lapse_reason
lapseReason.description: "expired", or the kind of the change that invalidated it.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageLastValid.title: CoverageLastValid
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageLastValid.description:
CoverageLastValid is the last ENFORCED record of a scope and why it no
 longer supports the claim (F442).

detail.title: detail
detail.description:
Detail from the probe, at most 512 characters. UNTRUSTED: it comes
 from the launcher's host; show it as text in the untrusted block.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageProbeResult.title: CoverageProbeResult
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageProbeResult.description: CoverageProbeResult is one probe, control or canary result of a closure.

state.title: state
state.description:
The state now: the computed state, downgraded to PARTIAL when ENFORCED
 expired or a change since invalidated it.

snapshotId.title: snapshot_id
snapshotId.description: The snapshot read; empty when none was computed yet (state UNKNOWN).

snapshotDigest.title: snapshot_digest
snapshotDigest.description:
"sha256:" and the hex digest of the snapshot's ledger body, which a
 receipt's coverage claim names (HR-217).

closureId.title: closure_id
closureId.description: The closure an ENFORCED state rests on.

lastValid.title: last_valid
lastValid.description: The last valid record, when this one is a downgrade.

invalidations.title: invalidations
invalidations.description: The changes after the snapshot that invalidate it.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRecord.title: CoverageRecord
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRecord.description: CoverageRecord is one scope's coverage as it reads now.

id.title: id
id.description: Inventory entry id; empty for a kind no source observed.

locator.title: locator
locator.description: Where it goes (a host, a file, an identity); untrusted text.

source.title: source
source.description:
Where the inventory learned of it: "gateway", "connection",
 "discovery", "scan", "probe" or "person".

mode.title: mode
mode.description: For a channel: the route mode last observed, "monitor" or "enforce".

closureId.title: closure_id
closureId.description: The closure that closed it, when closed.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRoute.title: CoverageRoute
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageRoute.description: CoverageRoute is one route of a scope.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageScope.title: CoverageScope
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageScope.description: CoverageScope names one agent, connection and operation.

routes.title: routes
routes.description: Every route and its status when it was computed.

closureId.title: closure_id
closureId.description: The closure an ENFORCED state rests on.

lastValidId.title: last_valid_id
lastValidId.description: The last ENFORCED snapshot a downgrade follows (F442).

invalidationId.title: invalidation_id
invalidationId.description: The change that caused the computation, when one did.

computeTime.title: compute_time
computeTime.description: When it was computed, and when ENFORCED expires.

ledgerEntryId.title: ledger_entry_id
ledgerEntryId.description: Its coverage.snapshot ledger entry and that entry's SHA-256.

pantherclaw.v1.CoverageSnapshot.title: CoverageSnapshot
pantherclaw.v1.CoverageSnapshot.description: CoverageSnapshot is one recorded computation of a scope's coverage.

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: Agent id; unset for every agent of the connection.

routeKind.title: route_kind
routeKind.description:
Route kind; unspecified excludes the whole scope. A channel is never
 excluded.

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: Agent id; unset for the connection alone.

pantherclaw.v1.GetAccessDetailRequest.title: GetAccessDetailRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetAccessDetailRequest.description: GetAccessDetailRequest names a connection, optionally one agent.

enforcedTtl.title: enforced_ttl
enforcedTtl.description: How long closure evidence supports ENFORCED.

reassessEvery.title: reassess_every
reassessEvery.description:
How often pending changes are reassessed at most
 (coverage.reassess_every).

invalidationKinds.title: invalidation_kinds
invalidationKinds.description:
The changes that invalidate closure evidence taken before them, and so
 drop ENFORCED at once. A new route, an exclusion and an expiry only
 make the scope be recomputed.

staleState.title: stale_state
staleState.description:

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why it is read (required; recorded in the audit ledger).

pantherclaw.v1.ReadPayloadCaptureRequest.title: ReadPayloadCaptureRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ReadPayloadCaptureRequest.description:
ReadPayloadCaptureRequest names a capture: a transaction's dispatch has
 at most one of each direction.

profileId.title: profile_id
profileId.description: The profile it was taken under.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: Whether content is cut to the profile's cap.

id.title: id
id.description: Hold id; it must be active.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why (stored and shown as untrusted text, never logged).

pending.title: pending
pending.description: A shortening recorded and not in effect yet, if any.

minDays.title: min_days
minDays.description: The bounds a revision must stay within, and the default.

revision.title: revision
revision.description: Revision number; 1 is the default the system recorded.

setBy.title: set_by
setBy.description: The person who set it; empty for the default.

effectiveTime.title: effective_time
effectiveTime.description: When it takes effect: at once, or 7 days after a shortening.

pantherclaw.v1.RetentionRevision.title: RetentionRevision
pantherclaw.v1.RetentionRevision.description: RetentionRevision is one recorded revision of a category's retention.

days.title: days
days.description: Days a body is kept; within the category's bounds.

changed.title: changed
changed.description: Whether a new revision was recorded (false when nothing changed).

shortened.title: shortened
shortened.description: Whether it shortens the period; it then takes effect 7 days later.

pantherclaw.v1.SetRetentionPolicyRespons.title: SetRetentionPolicyResponse
pantherclaw.v1.SetRetentionPolicyRespons.description: SetRetentionPolicyResponse returns the category after the change.

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: agent_id is empty for a credential right: every holder of it.

coverage.title: coverage
coverage.description: coverage is UNKNOWN, OBSERVE_ONLY, PARTIAL or ENFORCED.

basis.title: basis
basis.description:
basis explains the verb: ACCESS, EFFECT_KIND:<kind>, DEFAULT_UPDATE,
 DELEGATION or SCOPE_LEVEL.

automationIds.title: automation_ids
automationIds.description:
automation_ids name the automations the right belongs to: every
 automation that issued a grant behind an EFFECTIVE right's path (Team),
 or an ISSUANCE_CEILING right's one holder (Business). Empty for a
 caller without automation.read.

pantherclaw.v1.ExposureRight.title: ExposureRight
pantherclaw.v1.ExposureRight.description: ExposureRight is one thing an agent, or a credential's holder, can do.

stale.title: stale
stale.description: stale: a change was recorded after the computation (F258).

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: truncated: more rights than a snapshot holds; never complete.

gaps.title: gaps
gaps.description: gaps name what the computation could not read.

pantherclaw.v1.ExposureSnapshot.title: ExposureSnapshot
pantherclaw.v1.ExposureSnapshot.description: ExposureSnapshot says which computation a read comes from.

automationId.title: automation_id
automationId.description:
automation_id keeps one automation's rights (its execution reach, and
 its ceiling with the ISSUANCE_CEILING view); needs automation.read.

restricted.title: restricted
restricted.description:
restricted: the caller's scope is narrower than the org. It comes
 from the caller's permissions, never from whether hidden rows exist.

collapse.title: collapse
collapse.description: collapse merges repeated edges; gaps are never merged away.

includeCeiling.title: include_ceiling
includeCeiling.description:
include_ceiling adds automations' issuance-ceiling edges to authority
 and exposure graphs (D37a; Business, automation.read).

current.title: current
current.description: current counts current edges by kind; history is never in it.

asOf.title: as_of
asOf.description:
as_of is when the data was read; snapshot is set for authority and
 exposure graphs.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
kind: holds, allows, reaches, through, acted, touched, delegated,
 then, changed or gap.

basis.title: basis
basis.description: basis: OBSERVED, RULE_MATCH, INFERRED or HYPOTHESIS.

pantherclaw.v1.GraphFilter.title: GraphFilter
pantherclaw.v1.GraphFilter.description: GraphFilter narrows a graph; empty fields do not filter.

type.title: type
type.description:
type: run (a task), agent, incident, resource (a resource group) or
 automation (its issued grants and, when asked, its ceiling; authority
 and exposure modes, needs automation.read).

pantherclaw.v1.GraphScope.title: GraphScope
pantherclaw.v1.GraphScope.description: GraphScope is where a graph starts (F293).

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
kind: contain, revoke_grant, narrow_grant, revoke_credential,
 rotate_credential, quarantine_connection or suspend_agent.

control.title: control
control.description: control for contain: DENY_ALL, HOLD_WRITES or DENY_OPERATION.

removed.title: removed
removed.description: removed: current rights the reduction takes away.

weakened.title: weakened
weakened.description: weakened: rights that stay but become less usable.

remaining.title: remaining
remaining.description:
remaining: rights in the reduction's scope it does not reach (another
 grant, a credential, a route): containment is not closure (D31).

disruption.title: disruption
disruption.description: disruption: recently observed work whose effective right goes.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: truncated: the lists were cut at 500 rights each.

includeAutomations.title: include_automations
includeAutomations.description:
include_automations also ranks automations (G0 M11 D37a, F025, F754);
 needs automation.read.

automationsNote.title: automations_note
automationsNote.description:
automations_note says why automations are left out or not ranked by
 their ceiling (permission or edition).

pantherclaw.v1.RankKeys.title: RankKeys
pantherclaw.v1.RankKeys.description: RankKeys are the ranking's keys in order, each shown as is.

agentId.title: agent_id
agentId.description: agent_id is empty for credential holders.

ceilingKeys.title: ceiling_keys
ceilingKeys.description: ceiling_keys are the ceiling's keys (Business; empty below it).

ceilingAgents.title: ceiling_agents
ceilingAgents.description: ceiling_agents counts the ceiling agents it reaches through.

currentRights.title: current_rights
currentRights.description:
current_rights and active_grants are its execution reach (Team):
 shown beside the ceiling, never used to rank.

pantherclaw.v1.RankedAutomation.title: RankedAutomation
pantherclaw.v1.RankedAutomation.description:
RankedAutomation is one automation, ranked by its issuance ceiling,
 never by how much it ran (F754).

pantherclaw.v1.ReachCount.title: ReachCount
pantherclaw.v1.ReachCount.description: ReachCount counts current rights per view and label.

pantherclaw.v1.ReductionSubject.title: ReductionSubject
pantherclaw.v1.ReductionSubject.description: ReductionSubject names what a reduction acts on (D1 subject types).

pantherclaw.v1.FactType.title: FactType
pantherclaw.v1.FactType.description: FactType is the type of a fact's value.

subjectType.title: subject_type
subjectType.description: Target type the fact is about, for example payments.charge.

maxLag.title: max_lag
maxLag.description: How old an observation may be when it is recorded.

pantherclaw.v1.FactDeclaration.title: FactDeclaration
pantherclaw.v1.FactDeclaration.description: FactDeclaration is one fact a provider may write.

observeTime.title: observe_time
observeTime.description:
When the provider observed it; neither later than the server's clock
 nor older than the declaration's maximum lag.

pantherclaw.v1.FactObservation.title: FactObservation
pantherclaw.v1.FactObservation.description: FactObservation is one observation a provider reports.

serviceAccountId.title: service_account_id
serviceAccountId.description: The service account it authenticates as.

gatewayId.title: gateway_id
gatewayId.description:
For a gateway provider (G0 M8), the gateway that reads the connection's
 system of record, and that connection; service_account_id is then empty.

accepted.title: accepted
accepted.description:
Whether it was recorded. An observation older than the stored one is
 not recorded and not an error.

code.title: code
code.description: Why it was refused, for example FACT_NOT_DECLARED or FACT_IN_FUTURE.

pantherclaw.v1.FactResult.title: FactResult
pantherclaw.v1.FactResult.description: FactResult is the outcome of one observation.

pantherclaw.v1.ListFactsResponse.title: ListFactsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ListFactsResponse.description: ListFactsResponse returns the facts from active providers.

pantherclaw.v1.PutFactsResponse.title: PutFactsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.PutFactsResponse.description: PutFactsResponse returns one result per observation.

serviceAccountId.title: service_account_id
serviceAccountId.description:
The service account the provider authenticates as; or, for a gateway
 provider, empty.

gatewayId.title: gateway_id
gatewayId.description:
For a gateway provider (G0 M8 decision 5): the gateway that reads the
 connection's system of record and reports its facts, and the connection.

pantherclaw.v1.RegisterProviderRequest.title: RegisterProviderRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RegisterProviderRequest.description:
RegisterProviderRequest registers a provider.
a provider is bound to a service account, or to a gateway and one of its connections:
```
(this.service_account_id != '') != (this.gateway_id != '' && this.connection_id != '') && (this.gateway_id == '') == (this.connection_id == '')
```

connectionId.title: connection_id
connectionId.description:
The connection whose system of record was read; it must be served by
 the calling gateway and bound to its provider.

pantherclaw.v1.ReportFactsRequest.title: ReportFactsRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ReportFactsRequest.description:
ReportFactsRequest carries what a gateway read from one of its
 connections' systems of record just before a decision (G0 M8 decision 5,
 HR-160): for GitHub, a pull request's head and people, reviews, checks,
 branch rules and deploy triggers. The gateway is the connection's
 registered fact provider; the org and the gateway come from its
 certificate.

pantherclaw.v1.ReportFactsResponse.title: ReportFactsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ReportFactsResponse.description: ReportFactsResponse returns one result per observation.

pantherclaw.v1.ContainmentStateKind.title: ContainmentStateKind
pantherclaw.v1.ContainmentStateKind.description: ContainmentStateKind tells snapshots, changes and heartbeats apart.

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayCertificateState.title: GatewayCertificateState
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayCertificateState.description: GatewayCertificateState is whether a certificate is accepted.

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayState.title: GatewayState
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayState.description: GatewayState is whether a gateway may act.

userEmail.title: user_email
userEmail.description: Their email, for review (untrusted text from the identity provider).

userDisplayName.title: user_display_name
userDisplayName.description:
Their display name, for review (untrusted text from the identity
 provider).

name.title: name
name.description: The name the person gave the key.

credentialId.title: credential_id
credentialId.description: The WebAuthn credential id the authenticator signs with.

publicKey.title: public_key
publicKey.description: The public key as a DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (PKIX).

fingerprint.title: fingerprint
fingerprint.description: "sha256:" and 64 hex digits of public_key, for review.

pantherclaw.v1.ApproverKey.title: ApproverKey
pantherclaw.v1.ApproverKey.description: ApproverKey is one person's active security key (HR-038).

fingerprint.title: fingerprint
fingerprint.description: "sha256:" and 64 hex digits of the public key.

active.title: active
active.description: Whether it is the key credentials are sealed to.

pantherclaw.v1.BrokerKey.title: BrokerKey
pantherclaw.v1.BrokerKey.description: BrokerKey is a broker public key a gateway registered (HR-182).

pantherclaw.v1.ClaimVerificationsRequest.title: ClaimVerificationsRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ClaimVerificationsRequest.description: ClaimVerificationsRequest asks for due verification tasks.

pantherclaw.v1.CreateGatewayEnrollmentTo.title: CreateGatewayEnrollmentTokenRequest
pantherclaw.v1.CreateGatewayEnrollmentTo.description: CreateGatewayEnrollmentTokenRequest asks for a token for one gateway.

token.title: token
token.description: The `pcg_` token. It is never shown again.

caSha256.title: ca_sha256
caSha256.description: "sha256:" and 64 hex digits of the CA certificate the gateway must pin.

gatewayApiUrl.title: gateway_api_url
gatewayApiUrl.description: The URL of the server's gateway listener.

name.title: name
name.description: Lower-case name, unique among the org's active gateways.

configVersion.title: config_version
configVersion.description:
Version of what it serves; moves with every connection, route or
 credential change.

revokedBy.title: revoked_by
revokedBy.description: Who revoked it, when and why (UNTRUSTED text).

hosting.title: hosting
hosting.description:
hosting says who runs the gateway; PantherClaw-hosted ones come only
 from the server's configuration and run no connector (HR-084).

pantherclaw.v1.Gateway.title: Gateway
pantherclaw.v1.Gateway.description:
Gateway is one gateway record (one deployment; its replicas enroll
 separately and share the record).

connectionIds.title: connection_ids
connectionIds.description: The connections it covers that this gateway serves.

response.title: response
response.description: Capture the target's response (after secret-echo redaction).

expireTime.title: expire_time
expireTime.description: When it expires; the gateway stops capturing then.

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayCaptureProfile.title: GatewayCaptureProfile
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayCaptureProfile.description: GatewayCaptureProfile tells a gateway which bodies to capture.

id.title: id
id.description: Certificate id (in the certificate's URI SAN).

keyThumbprint.title: key_thumbprint
keyThumbprint.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the certificate's key.

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayCertificate.title: GatewayCertificate
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayCertificate.description: GatewayCertificate is one certificate the internal CA issued.

package.title: package
package.description: Package name and the org's pinned version.

baseUrl.title: base_url
baseUrl.description: Base URL (scheme, host, port), empty for local connections.

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts a credential may be sent to.

defaultMode.title: default_mode
defaultMode.description: Mode of routes without an explicit mode: "monitor" or "enforce".

agentHosts.title: agent_hosts
agentHosts.description:
agent_hosts are the host names agents use for the connection's API
 (G0 M9).

connector.title: connector
connector.description: connector is an mcp_container connection's spec.

github.title: github
github.description:
The GitHub App installation behind the connection (G0 M8, ADR-0021):
 an action on a repository of another account is refused before it is
 decided (WRONG_ACCOUNT); unset without a GitHub App credential.

simulated.title: simulated
simulated.description:
Whether the connection is simulated (G0 M12, HR-221): the gateway sends
 its traffic only after the simulator answers the handshake.

postgres.title: postgres
postgres.description:
postgres is a postgres connection's configuration and manifest (G0 M14
 D64).

a2a.title: a2a
a2a.description: a2a is an a2a connection's configuration and pinned card (D64).

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayConnection.title: GatewayConnection
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayConnection.description: GatewayConnection is a connection as its gateway sees it.

raw.title: raw
raw.description:
The package file as imported (the gateway decodes it strictly and
 derives every definition digest itself).

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayPackage.title: GatewayPackage
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayPackage.description: GatewayPackage is the exact signed bytes of a pinned package version.

csr.title: csr
csr.description: DER PKCS #10 certificate request for an Ed25519 key, signed by that key.

pantherclaw.v1.GatewayServiceEnrollReque.title: GatewayServiceEnrollRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GatewayServiceEnrollReque.description: GatewayServiceEnrollRequest exchanges a token for a certificate.

caCertificate.title: ca_certificate
caCertificate.description: DER CA certificate; the gateway checks its SHA-256 against its pin.

gatewayApiUrl.title: gateway_api_url
gatewayApiUrl.description: The URL of the server's gateway listener.

knownVersion.title: known_version
knownVersion.description:
The version the gateway already has; when it is current the response
 carries only the version.

pantherclaw.v1.GetConfigurationRequest.title: GetConfigurationRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetConfigurationRequest.description: GetConfigurationRequest asks for the gateway's configuration.

unchanged.title: unchanged
unchanged.description: Whether known_version is current (nothing else is set then).

orgId.title: org_id
orgId.description: Org id (the same as the certificate's).

connections.title: connections
connections.description: The connections this gateway serves (active and quarantined).

credentials.title: credentials
credentials.description: The active sealed credentials of those connections.

captureProfiles.title: capture_profiles
captureProfiles.description:
The active, unexpired capture profiles covering those connections
 (G0 M7 design decision 10, HR-199); none when capture is off.

pantherclaw.v1.GetConfigurationResponse.title: GetConfigurationResponse
pantherclaw.v1.GetConfigurationResponse.description: GetConfigurationResponse is what the gateway serves.

certificates.title: certificates
certificates.description: Its 20 most recent certificates, newest first.

pantherclaw.v1.ListApproverKeysRequest.title: ListApproverKeysRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ListApproverKeysRequest.description: ListApproverKeysRequest pages through the org's active security keys.

orgId.title: org_id
orgId.description: The org the keys belong to.

rpId.title: rp_id
rpId.description:
The WebAuthn relying party id the keys are registered for; assertions
 carry its SHA-256.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty at the end.

pantherclaw.v1.ListApproverKeysResponse.title: ListApproverKeysResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ListApproverKeysResponse.description: ListApproverKeysResponse is one page, with what every page shares.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty at the end.

pantherclaw.v1.MintTestActionTokensReque.title: MintTestActionTokensRequest
pantherclaw.v1.MintTestActionTokensReque.description: MintTestActionTokensRequest names a leased target_verifier test.

token.title: token
token.description: Binds the test read's empty body: sent fresh, then again as a replay.

mismatchToken.title: mismatch_token
mismatchToken.description: Binds another body: the verifier must refuse it.

pantherclaw.v1.MintTestActionTokensRespo.title: MintTestActionTokensResponse
pantherclaw.v1.MintTestActionTokensRespo.description: MintTestActionTokensResponse carries the test's action tokens.

publicKey.title: public_key
publicKey.description:
Seal public key: X-Wing (MLKEM768-X25519), 1,216 bytes, or
 MLKEM768-P256 from a FIPS gateway, 1,249 bytes (G0 M13 D35).
the broker key must be an X-Wing (1,216 bytes) or MLKEM768-P256 (1,249 bytes) public key:
```
size(this) == 1216 || size(this) == 1249
```

pantherclaw.v1.RegisterBrokerKeyRequest.title: RegisterBrokerKeyRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RegisterBrokerKeyRequest.description: RegisterBrokerKeyRequest registers a broker public key.

csr.title: csr
csr.description: DER PKCS #10 certificate request for a new Ed25519 key.

pantherclaw.v1.RenewCertificateRequest.title: RenewCertificateRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RenewCertificateRequest.description: RenewCertificateRequest asks for a certificate for a new key.

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
Why the gateway opened the circuit; empty for the UNKNOWN-threshold
 breaker (G0 M14 D76).

quarantined.title: quarantined
quarantined.description: Whether the connection is now quarantined.

pantherclaw.v1.ReportCircuitResponse.title: ReportCircuitResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ReportCircuitResponse.description: ReportCircuitResponse says what the server did.

expectedDigest.title: expected_digest
expectedDigest.description: Digest the package was reviewed against.

observedDigest.title: observed_digest
observedDigest.description: Digest observed now; empty when the tool is gone.

observedDescription.title: observed_description
observedDescription.description:
The tool description the gateway observed in the upstream listing, for
 the instruction-like content scan (G0 M10 D47, PN-006.2). Unset from
 older gateways: the scan is then recorded as not_scanned.

observedDescriptionTruncated.title: observed_description_truncated
observedDescriptionTruncated.description:
Whether the gateway cut observed_description to 8 KiB: the scan then
 covers a prefix only and is recorded as partial, never clean (D59 M8).

observedDescriptionSha256.title: observed_description_sha256
observedDescriptionSha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole observed description, "sha256:<hex>".

pantherclaw.v1.ReportDriftRequest.title: ReportDriftRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ReportDriftRequest.description: ReportDriftRequest reports an upstream tool that no longer matches.

quarantined.title: quarantined
quarantined.description: Whether the package pin is now quarantined.

pantherclaw.v1.ReportDriftResponse.title: ReportDriftResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ReportDriftResponse.description: ReportDriftResponse says what the server did.

httpStatus.title: http_status
httpStatus.description: The target's HTTP status; 0 when the read failed before an answer.

found.title: found
found.description:
Whether the object was found (by reference: a 2xx answer; in a
 listing: an item carrying the correlation value).

complete.title: complete
complete.description: Whether a listing was read to its end.

fields.title: fields
fields.description: The fields the verifier declares, by JSON pointer, as text.

responseDigest.title: response_digest
responseDigest.description: SHA-256 of the answer the fields were read from.

items.title: items
items.description:
For a target-log task (HR-112): the objects the target created in the
 window, as listed. Empty for every other task.

installationPermissions.title: installation_permissions
installationPermissions.description:
For an org-scan task (G0 M8, F048): the permissions of the GitHub App
 installation the lease names, as the scan read them with the App's JWT
 (which mints no token), name to level. Unset when it was not read: the
 server then keeps what it had, so unread permissions stay "not
 observed".

installationRepositorySelection.title: installation_repository_selection
installationRepositorySelection.description: Its repository selection: "all" or "selected"; empty when not read.

effectState.title: effect_state
effectState.description: The effect state the observation shows; empty when inconclusive.

pantherclaw.v1.ReportObservationResponse.title: ReportObservationResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ReportObservationResponse.description: ReportObservationResponse says what the report changed.

connectionId.title: connection_id
connectionId.description: Connection id: one the calling gateway serves.

repository.title: repository
repository.description:
The repository the token was narrowed to (owner/repo); empty for a
 scan token over several.

expireTime.title: expire_time
expireTime.description: When GitHub said the token expires.

pantherclaw.v1.ReportRevocationFailureRe.title: ReportRevocationFailureRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ReportRevocationFailureRe.description: ReportRevocationFailureRequest names the token that was not revoked.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why (stored and shown as untrusted text).

allowedHosts.title: allowed_hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts it may be sent to (bound into the seal).

scheme.title: scheme
scheme.description: Optional scheme before it, for example "Bearer".

kind.title: kind
kind.description: Kind, bound into the seal: "static" or "github_app" (G0 M8).

pantherclaw.v1.SealedCredential.title: SealedCredential
pantherclaw.v1.SealedCredential.description:
SealedCredential is one connection's sealed credential (HR-060). Only
 the gateway holding the broker key can open it.

objectRef.title: object_ref
objectRef.description: The object's id at the target.

correlation.title: correlation
correlation.description:
Its correlation value (the idempotency key it was created with), empty
 when it has none.

created.title: created
created.description: When the target created it (unix seconds), 0 when unknown.

pantherclaw.v1.TargetLogItem.title: TargetLogItem
pantherclaw.v1.TargetLogItem.description: TargetLogItem is one object a target log lists.

lease.title: lease
lease.description: The lease's single-use secret, returned with the report.

operation.title: operation
operation.description: The read operation of the connection's pinned package.

request.title: request
request.description:
The read the server computed, as JSON: mode (reference | lookup),
 target and params.

correlate.title: correlate
correlate.description:
The idempotency key an item of a listing must carry to be the write's
 effect (pc-<transaction>).

pantherclaw.v1.VerificationLease.title: VerificationLease
pantherclaw.v1.VerificationLease.description: VerificationLease is one leased task: the reviewed read to make.

killSwitch.title: kill_switch
killSwitch.description: Whether the org kill switch is engaged.

gatewayActive.title: gateway_active
gatewayActive.description: Whether the gateway itself is still active.

connections.title: connections
connections.description: States of the connections the gateway serves (snapshots and changes).

verificationsWaiting.title: verifications_waiting
verificationsWaiting.description:
Whether verification tasks are due on the active connections the
 gateway serves (G0 M7 design decision 1), in every message kind: a hint
 to claim them now instead of at its next poll. It never changes what
 the gateway may dispatch, and without it the gateway still polls.

pantherclaw.v1.WatchContainmentResponse.title: WatchContainmentResponse
pantherclaw.v1.WatchContainmentResponse.description:
WatchContainmentResponse is the org's containment as the server last confirmed
 it from the database.

pantherclaw.v1.PrincipalSource.title: PrincipalSource
pantherclaw.v1.PrincipalSource.description: PrincipalSource says how the represented principal was established.

pantherclaw.v1.SubjectTokenType.title: SubjectTokenType
pantherclaw.v1.SubjectTokenType.description: SubjectTokenType is the RFC 8693 type of a subject token.

pantherclaw.v1.Actor.title: Actor
pantherclaw.v1.Actor.description: Actor is one party in a run's actor chain.

states.title: states
states.description: Only runs in these states (all when empty).

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

id.title: id
id.description: Run id, minted by the Authority.

instanceId.title: instance_id
instanceId.description: Bound instance; empty until the first instance uses the run.

subjectIssuer.title: subject_issuer
subjectIssuer.description: For a subject token: the provider's issuer.

subjectSubject.title: subject_subject
subjectSubject.description: For a subject token: the user's subject at the provider.

parentRunId.title: parent_run_id
parentRunId.description: Parent run, for a child run.

depth.title: depth
depth.description: Nesting depth; 0 for a top-level run.

taskRef.title: task_ref
taskRef.description: UNTRUSTED task label from the launcher; it never changes scope.

grantId.title: grant_id
grantId.description:
The grant whose authority the run uses; empty for a run without one,
 whose actions are denied (NO_GRANT).

instanceId.title: instance_id
instanceId.description:
Optional admitted instance to bind; otherwise the first instance of the
 agent that uses the run is bound.

subjectToken.title: subject_token
subjectToken.description:
