pantherclaw.v1.StepState.title: StepState
pantherclaw.v1.StepState.description: StepState is whether a step is done.

id.title: id
id.description: Record id in the caller's org.

pantherclaw.v1.EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
pantherclaw.v1.EvidenceRef.description:
EvidenceRef names a record that completed a step. The kinds are fixed
 per step: SECURITY_KEY "security_key" (the credential id); INVITE_TEAM
 "invitation"; GATEWAY_ENROLLED "gateway"; AGENT_ENROLLED "agent";
 FIRST_DECISION "decision" (the transaction whose decision receipt it
 is); TEST_ALLOWED and TEST_DENIED "transaction"; TEST_HELD "approval"
 (the approval request) and "transaction"; APPROVAL_DECIDED "approval";
 SUSPENSION_TESTED "suspension" (the agent change that suspended it).

pantherclaw.v1.GetProgressRequest.title: GetProgressRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetProgressRequest.description: GetProgressRequest asks for the caller's org's progress.

steps.title: steps
steps.description: Steps, in the order the console shows them.

complete.title: complete
complete.description:
Whether every required step is done: all but INVITE_TEAM and
 APPROVAL_DECIDED, which a person alone in a new org cannot finish
 (they stay follow-up steps). TEST_HELD is done once a hold is recorded.

pantherclaw.v1.GetProgressResponse.title: GetProgressResponse
pantherclaw.v1.GetProgressResponse.description: GetProgressResponse returns every step in order.

doneAt.title: done_at
doneAt.description: When the step was first done; unset while it is to do.

pantherclaw.v1.Ambiguity.title: Ambiguity
pantherclaw.v1.Ambiguity.description:
Ambiguity is a phrase that names more than one record the caller may
 read.

pantherclaw.v1.AskResponse.title: AskResponse
pantherclaw.v1.AskResponse.description:
AskResponse is the interpretation and, unless it needs clarification,
 the first page of results.

pantherclaw.v1.BuiltinParams.title: BuiltinParams
pantherclaw.v1.BuiltinParams.description:
BuiltinParams are a built-in query's parameters; each query takes only
 its own.

pantherclaw.v1.BuiltinQuery.title: BuiltinQuery
pantherclaw.v1.BuiltinQuery.description: BuiltinQuery is one built-in query with its parameters.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: More rows matched than the 10000 exported.

auditEntryId.title: audit_entry_id
auditEntryId.description: The audit ledger entry that records the export.

count.title: count
count.description: Matching records in the caller's scope, at most 10000.

countPrefixOnly.title: count_prefix_only
countPrefixOnly.description:
Name prefixes filled the limit: count covers ids and name prefixes
 only, not names that contain the text elsewhere.

label.title: label
label.description: The name or title, else what identifies the record.

pantherclaw.v1.FindMatch.title: FindMatch
pantherclaw.v1.FindMatch.description: FindMatch is one record quick find matched.

text.title: text
text.description:
2 to 100 characters: an id, an id prefix of at least 8 hex digits, or
 part of a name or title (matched literally, ignoring case).

kinds.title: kinds
kinds.description: The kinds to match; none: every kind.

pantherclaw.v1.FindResponse.title: FindResponse
pantherclaw.v1.FindResponse.description:
FindResponse lists the matches of each kind the caller may read; kinds
 it may not read are omissions ("outside your permissions").

timezone.title: timezone
timezone.description: The IANA time zone "today" and dates are read in (default UTC).

query.title: query
query.description:
The query it became: exactly one of query and builtin, unless
 needs_clarification.

entity.title: entity
entity.description: The entity or built-in query searched.

eventMeaning.title: event_meaning
eventMeaning.description:
What action rows mean: "ATTEMPTS", "CONFIRMED", "DECISIONS" or
 "EFFECTS"; empty for other entities.

matched.title: matched
matched.description: Each phrase understood and what it became.

needsClarification.title: needs_clarification
needsClarification.description: Nothing runs until the question is clarified.

pantherclaw.v1.Interpretation.title: Interpretation
pantherclaw.v1.Interpretation.description: Interpretation is how a question was read.

pantherclaw.v1.Omission.title: Omission
pantherclaw.v1.Omission.description:
Omission is what a result cannot show, from the caller's permissions or
 from what PantherClaw does not observe.

itemIds.title: item_ids
itemIds.description: The chosen results' ids, as the search returned them.

pantherclaw.v1.OpenCaseFromResultsReques.title: OpenCaseFromResultsRequest
pantherclaw.v1.OpenCaseFromResultsReques.description: OpenCaseFromResultsRequest opens a case from chosen results.

pantherclaw.v1.RunBuiltinQueryResponse.title: RunBuiltinQueryResponse
pantherclaw.v1.RunBuiltinQueryResponse.description: RunBuiltinQueryResponse is one page of a built-in query.

pantherclaw.v1.RunSavedQueryResponse.title: RunSavedQueryResponse
pantherclaw.v1.RunSavedQueryResponse.description: RunSavedQueryResponse is one page of a saved query.

teamId.title: team_id
teamId.description: The team a TEAM query is shared with.

query.title: query
query.description: Exactly one of query and builtin is set.

mine.title: mine
mine.description: The caller owns it and may change it.

query.title: query
query.description: Exactly one of query and builtin.

pantherclaw.v1.SavedQueryInput.title: SavedQueryInput
pantherclaw.v1.SavedQueryInput.description: SavedQueryInput is what a saved query holds.

usedConnectionId.title: used_connection_id
usedConnectionId.description: Agents that used this connection in the range.

unusedSince.title: unused_since
unusedSince.description: Grants with no recorded use since then.

widensOnly.title: widens_only
widensOnly.description: Grant changes: only new grants and widening revisions.

severities.title: severities
severities.description: Alert, incident and finding severities (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

effectStates.title: effect_states
effectStates.description: Transaction effect states (CONFIRMED, NONE_CONFIRMED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, ...).

pantherclaw.v1.SearchFilters.title: SearchFilters
pantherclaw.v1.SearchFilters.description:
SearchFilters are the typed filters of a structured query. Each entity
 accepts only its own; anything else is refused.

label.title: label
label.description:
A distinction the row carries: ATTEMPT or CONFIRMED, ENFORCED or
 SHADOW, MATERIAL or NARROWING_OR_METADATA, VERIFIED, DECLARED or
 UNCLASSIFIED, else the row's state.

pantherclaw.v1.SearchItem.title: SearchItem
pantherclaw.v1.SearchItem.description:
SearchItem is one result row: scalar fields and links to supporting
 evidence ("<kind>:<id>").

pantherclaw.v1.SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
pantherclaw.v1.SearchResponse.description: SearchResponse is one page of a structured query.

count.title: count
count.description: Matching rows in the caller's scope, at most 10000.

scopePermission.title: scope_permission
scopePermission.description:
The permission the rows are read with, and whether the caller holds it
 across the whole organization.

rangeStartTime.title: range_start_time
rangeStartTime.description: The evidence range covered; unset ends are open.

rangeChanging.title: range_changing
rangeChanging.description: The range reaches the present, so its results may still change.

emptyReason.title: empty_reason
emptyReason.description:
Why the first page is empty: "NOTHING_IN_SCOPE", "NO_DATA_COLLECTED"
 or "RESTRICTED"; empty when there are results.

pantherclaw.v1.SearchResult.title: SearchResult
pantherclaw.v1.SearchResult.description: SearchResult is one page of results.

pantherclaw.v1.SearchSource.title: SearchSource
pantherclaw.v1.SearchSource.description:
SearchSource names a search: exactly one of a structured query, a
 built-in query and a saved query.

metrics.title: metrics
metrics.description: Metrics to read; all when empty.

pantherclaw.v1.GetMetricsRequest.title: GetMetricsRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetMetricsRequest.description: GetMetricsRequest names the metrics and range.

pantherclaw.v1.GetMetricsResponse.title: GetMetricsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.GetMetricsResponse.description: GetMetricsResponse is one series per metric and dimension.

counts.title: counts
counts.description:
Counts by key: active_incidents, open_alerts, critical,
 protection_failures, expiring_decisions, authority_expansion_24h,
 unconfirmed_containment, posture_findings, automation_exceptions,
 telemetry_gaps.

unknown.title: unknown
unknown.description: What the summary cannot vouch for.

statement.title: statement
statement.description: The summary in one paragraph; never a claim that nothing is wrong.

scopeWhole.title: scope_whole
scopeWhole.description:
The caller reads across the whole organization; otherwise items about
 agents outside its scope are left out.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: A source held more items than were read.

pendingSources.title: pending_sources
pendingSources.description: Queue sources this server does not report yet.

pantherclaw.v1.GetWorkQueueResponse.title: GetWorkQueueResponse
pantherclaw.v1.GetWorkQueueResponse.description: GetWorkQueueResponse is the ranked queue, highest severity first.

state.title: state
state.description:
"COLLECTED", "NOT_COLLECTED" (the source is not collected),
 "RESTRICTED" (the caller may not read the source across the
 organization) or
 "NO_SAMPLE" (no sample was taken: a gap).

drillQuery.title: drill_query
drillQuery.description: The search behind the point (drill-down); one of query and builtin.

dimension.title: dimension
dimension.description: A breakdown key (a resource group), empty for the whole organization.

pantherclaw.v1.MetricSeries.title: MetricSeries
pantherclaw.v1.MetricSeries.description: MetricSeries is one metric and dimension over the range.

gap.title: gap
gap.description: STALE or NEVER: a gap in the evidence.

lag.title: lag
lag.description: Feed entries detection has yet to read.

permission.title: permission
permission.description: The permission it needs (the caller holds it for the item).

pantherclaw.v1.WorkAction.title: WorkAction
pantherclaw.v1.WorkAction.description: WorkAction is an action the caller may take on a work item.

title.title: title
title.description: Untrusted text where it comes from a rule or a report.

pantherclaw.v1.PackageState.title: PackageState
pantherclaw.v1.PackageState.description: PackageState is a package version's lifecycle state (F394).

pantherclaw.v1.SigningKeyRevokeReason.title: SigningKeyRevokeReason
pantherclaw.v1.SigningKeyRevokeReason.description: SigningKeyRevokeReason says why a key was revoked.

pantherclaw.v1.SigningKeyState.title: SigningKeyState
pantherclaw.v1.SigningKeyState.description: SigningKeyState is an org package-signing key's state.

digest.title: digest
digest.description: Definition digest ("sha256:" and 64 hex digits), as ActionIR pins it.

pantherclaw.v1.DefinitionRef.title: DefinitionRef
pantherclaw.v1.DefinitionRef.description: DefinitionRef names one action definition of a package.

pantherclaw.v1.ImportPackageRequest.title: ImportPackageRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ImportPackageRequest.description:
ImportPackageRequest carries a package and the signed metadata that
 lists it.

alreadyImported.title: already_imported
alreadyImported.description: Whether the same bytes were already imported (nothing changed).

fileDigest.title: file_digest
fileDigest.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the exact signed package bytes.

pinned.title: pinned
pinned.description: Whether the org's pin points at this version.

signingKey.title: signing_key
signingKey.description:
Kid of the org package-signing key that signed it; empty when
 PantherClaw's package root did.

pantherclaw.v1.PackageVersion.title: PackageVersion
pantherclaw.v1.PackageVersion.description: PackageVersion is one imported package version.

publicJwk.title: public_jwk
publicJwk.description: The Ed25519 public key as a JWK (JSON). Private members are refused.

pantherclaw.v1.RegisterSigningKeyRequest.title: RegisterSigningKeyRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RegisterSigningKeyRequest.description:
RegisterSigningKeyRequest carries the public half of a key the org keeps
 offline (pclaw package key create).

pantherclaw.v1.RevokeSigningKeyRequest.title: RevokeSigningKeyRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RevokeSigningKeyRequest.description: RevokeSigningKeyRequest names a key and why it is revoked.

withdrawn.title: withdrawn
withdrawn.description: For COMPROMISED: each version withdrawn, with its new state.

pantherclaw.v1.RevokeSigningKeyResponse.title: RevokeSigningKeyResponse
pantherclaw.v1.RevokeSigningKeyResponse.description: RevokeSigningKeyResponse returns the key and what was withdrawn.

kid.title: kid
kid.description: Key id: "org-packages-" and the start of the key's JWK thumbprint.

publicJwk.title: public_jwk
publicJwk.description: The public key as a JWK (JSON).

metadataVersion.title: metadata_version
metadataVersion.description:
The highest targets version accepted under it (0 before its first
 import). Sign the next targets with a higher version.

pantherclaw.v1.SigningKey.title: SigningKey
pantherclaw.v1.SigningKey.description: SigningKey is an org package-signing key (its public half only).

agentIds.title: agent_ids
agentIds.description: agent_ids or cohort_id (a fleet cohort), not both; at most 50 agents.

policyVersionId.title: policy_version_id
policyVersionId.description: policy_version_id is the DRAFT version the pack made.

skipped.title: skipped
skipped.description: skipped are per-agent rules left out because no agent was named.

template.title: template
template.description: template is the policy template it applies (pclaw template show).

covers.title: covers
covers.description: covers lists what the pack protects.

parameters.title: parameters
parameters.description:
parameters are what ApplyPack needs besides the environment and the
 agents: repos, default_branch, workspace, time_zone, payees, customers,
 slack_channels.

automationTemplate.title: automation_template
automationTemplate.description:
automation_template, when set, names the automation template that
 launches the pack's agents.

bounds.title: bounds
bounds.description: bounds and limits are grant bounds and limits v1, JSON.

pantherclaw.v1.PackBaseline.title: PackBaseline
pantherclaw.v1.PackBaseline.description: PackBaseline is the grant a person may issue an agent from the pack.

bundle.title: bundle
bundle.description: Policy bundle v1 (JSON: id and rules). The server assigns the version.

expectedCurrentVersion.title: expected_current_version
expectedCurrentVersion.description:
When set, the call fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION
 (POLICY_PUBLISHED_CHANGED) unless the org's published version is this
 one, or, when empty, unless none is published: a client that edited the
 published bundle never replaces a version published meanwhile.

fromId.title: from_id
fromId.description: The base; unset: the published version (or none).

outcomes.title: outcomes
outcomes.description:
The decisions that change over validation's samples (JSON array);
 sample-based, so an empty list proves nothing (R-25).

pantherclaw.v1.GetPublishedPolicyRequest.title: GetPublishedPolicyRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetPublishedPolicyRequest.description: GetPublishedPolicyRequest asks for the published version.

version.title: version
version.description: The published version; unset when nothing is published.

versions.title: versions
versions.description: Versions, newest first, without their bundles.

subjectId.title: subject_id
subjectId.description: What it changes: the version, rollout or exception id.

baseVersionId.title: base_version_id
baseVersionId.description: The published version it was made against; empty for none.

required.title: required
required.description:
Confirmations needed: 2 when the org had two or more people holding
 policy.publish when it was made, else 1.

decidedReason.title: decided_reason
decidedReason.description: Why it ended (BASE_CHANGED, STALE_TESTS, EXPIRED, or a decline's reason).

summary.title: summary
summary.description: What the confirmers are shown (JSON): the classified changes.

binding.title: binding
binding.description: What each confirmer's security key signs.

url.title: url
url.description: The page people confirm it on.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyChangeRequest.title: PolicyChangeRequest
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyChangeRequest.description:
PolicyChangeRequest is a change waiting for, or done with, confirmations
 (G0 M11.1 design decision 11).

direction.title: direction
direction.description:
"TIGHTER", "LOOSER", "UNKNOWN" or "NEUTRAL" overall: LOOSER and UNKNOWN
 need confirmations to publish.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyDiff.title: PolicyDiff
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyDiff.description: PolicyDiff is a classified comparison (G0 M11.1 design decision 3).

code.title: code
code.description: For example CONFLICT, OPERATION_UNKNOWN or SHADOWED.

example.title: example
example.description: An action that shows it (JSON), when there is one.

sampleBased.title: sample_based
sampleBased.description: Found on generated samples: absence of the finding proves nothing (R-25).

field.title: field
field.description: The field that changed, for CHANGED.

publishTime.title: publish_time
publishTime.description: When it was published; unset if never.

contentDigest.title: content_digest
contentDigest.description:
SHA-256 of the bundle without its version; empty for a version stored
 before the publish gate, which can never be published again.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyVersion.title: PolicyVersion
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyVersion.description: PolicyVersion is one stored bundle version.

expectedCurrentVersion.title: expected_current_version
expectedCurrentVersion.description:
When set, the call fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION
 (POLICY_PUBLISHED_CHANGED) unless the org's published version is this
 one, or, when empty, unless none is published: a client that edited the
 published bundle never replaces a version published meanwhile.

version.title: version
version.description:
The version (without the bundle): PUBLISHED, or TESTED while a change
 request waits.

changeRequest.title: change_request
changeRequest.description:
Set when the version loosens the published policy: it is published
 once enough people confirm this request at its url.

diff.title: diff
diff.description: The classified changes against the published version.

tests.title: tests
tests.description: The test run of this call.

toVersionId.title: to_version_id
toVersionId.description: The earlier version whose rules and tests to publish again.

expectedCurrentVersion.title: expected_current_version
expectedCurrentVersion.description:
When set, the call fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION
 (POLICY_PUBLISHED_CHANGED) unless the org's published version is this
 one, or, when empty, unless none is published.

pantherclaw.v1.RollbackPolicyRequest.title: RollbackPolicyRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RollbackPolicyRequest.description: RollbackPolicyRequest names the version to go back to.

version.title: version
version.description:
The new version (without the bundle): PUBLISHED, or TESTED while a
 change request waits.

changeRequest.title: change_request
changeRequest.description: Set when the rollback loosens the published policy.

carriedRuleIds.title: carried_rule_ids
carriedRuleIds.description: The emergency rules of the published version carried forward.

diff.title: diff
diff.description: The classified changes against the published version.

pantherclaw.v1.SurvivingMutant.title: SurvivingMutant
pantherclaw.v1.SurvivingMutant.description: SurvivingMutant is a mutant of a rule that no case killed.

passed.title: passed
passed.description: Whether the decision, reason (and rule) matched.

pantherclaw.v1.TestPolicyVersionResponse.title: TestPolicyVersionResponse
pantherclaw.v1.TestPolicyVersionResponse.description: TestPolicyVersionResponse returns the version and the report.

passed.title: passed
passed.description: Whether every case passed and every mutant was killed.

error.title: error
error.description: Why the run stopped, for example TESTS_TOO_LARGE; empty otherwise.

definitionsDigest.title: definitions_digest
definitionsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the active definitions it ran with.

catalogDigest.title: catalog_digest
catalogDigest.description: SHA-256 over the fact catalog it ran with.

pantherclaw.v1.TestReport.title: TestReport
pantherclaw.v1.TestReport.description: TestReport is one scenario test run (HR-044).

pantherclaw.v1.ValidatePolicyVersionResp.title: ValidatePolicyVersionResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ValidatePolicyVersionResp.description: ValidatePolicyVersionResponse returns the version and the report.

passed.title: passed
passed.description: Whether nothing blocks publication (no ERROR finding).

definitionsDigest.title: definitions_digest
definitionsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the active definitions it ran with.

catalogDigest.title: catalog_digest
catalogDigest.description: SHA-256 over the fact catalog it ran with.

pantherclaw.v1.ValidationReport.title: ValidationReport
pantherclaw.v1.ValidationReport.description: ValidationReport is one validation (G0 M11.1 design decision 8).

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty at the end.

ruleDigest.title: rule_digest
ruleDigest.description: SHA-256 of the rule as requested, hex; a changed rule is not waived.

operations.title: operations
operations.description: The exact operations it applies to.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why, in the requester's words (untrusted text).

requestedExpireTime.title: requested_expire_time
requestedExpireTime.description:
The expiry asked for; the exception ends then or 30 days after it
 became active, whichever comes first.

activateTime.title: activate_time
activateTime.description: When it became active; unset before.

expireTime.title: expire_time
expireTime.description: When it ends; unset before it is active.

revokedBy.title: revoked_by
revokedBy.description: Who revoked it; empty unless revoked.

ruleId.title: rule_id
ruleId.description: The rule id in the published version.

operations.title: operations
operations.description: Exact operations inside the rule's scope.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why the rule should not apply (1 to 500 characters).

expiresInSeconds.title: expires_in_seconds
expiresInSeconds.description: How long it should last, in seconds: at most 30 days.

ownerId.title: owner_id
ownerId.description: The person accountable for it; unset: the requester.

changeRequestUrl.title: change_request_url
changeRequestUrl.description: The page where it is confirmed.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutStage.title: PolicyRolloutStage
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutStage.description: PolicyRolloutStage is where a rollout is.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutTargetState.title: PolicyRolloutTargetState
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutTargetState.description: PolicyRolloutTargetState is where one agent of a rollout is (F3).

added.title: added
added.description: added counts the agents that were not members yet.

changeRequest.title: change_request
changeRequest.description: change_request is set when the publish waits for confirmation.

label.title: label
label.description: label is always "shadow prediction, not enforcement".

newlyHeldPerDay.title: newly_held_per_day
newlyHeldPerDay.description: newly_held_per_day is the approval burden the version would add.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description:
truncated: past 100 000 results, only total, by_category and by_day
 grew.

expandedExposure.title: expanded_exposure
expandedExposure.description:
expanded_exposure counts the NEWLY_ALLOWED evaluations: what the version
 would allow that was held or denied; expanded_exposure_note says so.

state.title: state
state.description: state filters by state; unspecified lists every state.

pageToken.title: page_token
pageToken.description: page_token is the last agent id of the previous page.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyChangeRequestRef.title: PolicyChangeRequestRef
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyChangeRequestRef.description: PolicyChangeRequestRef names a change request a person must confirm.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyCohort.title: PolicyCohort
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyCohort.description: PolicyCohort is a named group of agents.

baseVersionId.title: base_version_id
baseVersionId.description:
base_version_id is the version published when the rollout started;
 empty when none was. A pilot or completion needs it still published.

targetCounts.title: target_counts
targetCounts.description: target_counts counts the targets by state name.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRollout.title: PolicyRollout
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRollout.description: PolicyRollout is a rollout with its cohorts and target counts.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutCohort.title: PolicyRolloutCohort
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutCohort.description: PolicyRolloutCohort is one of a rollout's cohorts: SHADOW or ENFORCE.

ownerId.title: owner_id
ownerId.description:
owner_id is the agent's owner, who resolves a target that does not
 verify.

coverage.title: coverage
coverage.description:
coverage is the weakest coverage state seen for the version's
 operations.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutTarget.title: PolicyRolloutTarget
pantherclaw.v1.PolicyRolloutTarget.description: PolicyRolloutTarget is one agent of a rollout.

removed.title: removed
removed.description: removed counts the agents that were members.

category.title: category
category.description:
category is UNCHANGED, NEWLY_DENIED, NEWLY_HELD, NEWLY_CONSTRAINED,
 NEWLY_ALLOWED (expanded exposure), REASON_CHANGED or UNEVALUABLE.

pantherclaw.v1.ShadowCount.title: ShadowCount
pantherclaw.v1.ShadowCount.description:
ShadowCount is a count of one category: on a UTC day (key YYYY-MM-DD),
 for an operation, or for an agent (key the agent id).

limitation.title: limitation
limitation.description: limitation lists why an UNEVALUABLE replay could not run, by code.

pantherclaw.v1.ShadowSample.title: ShadowSample
pantherclaw.v1.ShadowSample.description: ShadowSample is one shadow result: ids, decisions and reasons only.

changeRequest.title: change_request
changeRequest.description: change_request is set when the pilot waits for confirmation.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationCategory.title: PolicySimulationCategory
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationCategory.description:
PolicySimulationCategory is what the version changes about one recorded
 decision.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationState.title: PolicySimulationState
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationState.description: PolicySimulationState is where a simulation is in its life.

category.title: category
category.description: category: only this category (unspecified: every category).

contentDigest.title: content_digest
contentDigest.description:
content_digest is the version's content digest (SHA-256, lowercase
 hex) when the simulation was asked for.

evaluated.title: evaluated
evaluated.description: evaluated is how many recorded decisions it has counted.

newlyHeldPerDay.title: newly_held_per_day
newlyHeldPerDay.description:
The approval burden forecast: decisions newly held, per day and by
 required role.

notices.title: notices
notices.description:
notices flag what needs attention (expanded exposure, unevaluable
 decisions, a cap reached).

limits.title: limits
limits.description: limits says what a simulation can and cannot predict.

error.title: error
error.description: error is why a FAILED simulation stopped.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationCounts.title: PolicySimulationCounts
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationCounts.description: PolicySimulationCounts counts recorded decisions by category.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationDay.title: PolicySimulationDay
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationDay.description:
PolicySimulationDay is the decisions newly held on one day (UTC), by
 the day they were recorded.

key.title: key
key.description: key is the operation, or the agent's id.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationGroup.title: PolicySimulationGroup
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationGroup.description: PolicySimulationGroup is the counts of one operation or one agent.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationRole.title: PolicySimulationRole
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationRole.description:
PolicySimulationRole is the decisions newly held for one approver role;
 "step_up" for a step-up, "other" when no rule of the version names one.

proposedDecision.title: proposed_decision
proposedDecision.description: proposed_decision and proposed_reason are empty when unevaluable.

limitations.title: limitations
limitations.description: limitations are the codes that made it unevaluable.

pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationSample.title: PolicySimulationSample
pantherclaw.v1.PolicySimulationSample.description:
PolicySimulationSample is one recorded decision and what the version
 would have decided: ids, decisions and reason codes only (HR-237).

days.title: days
days.description:
days is the window, ending now (0: 7 days). It may not reach back
 past what retention keeps.

maxEvaluations.title: max_evaluations
maxEvaluations.description: max_evaluations bounds the recorded decisions replayed (0: 10 000).

restricted.title: restricted
restricted.description: restricted: the caller's scope is narrower than the org.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
kind: excessive_grant, uncovered_path, unowned_agent,
 unsafe_delegation, stale_credential, unused_authority,
 unverified_sensitive_tool or credential_overreach.

affectedPaths.title: affected_paths
affectedPaths.description: affected_paths are what a remediation must reach.

changeRequestId.title: change_request_id
changeRequestId.description: The pending change's change request id.

change.title: change
change.description: The change (EMERGENCY, with its review request).

changeRequestId.title: change_request_id
changeRequestId.description: The change request two other people confirm.

pantherclaw.v1.ClearCompromiseResponse.title: ClearCompromiseResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ClearCompromiseResponse.description: ClearCompromiseResponse returns the request to confirm.

id.title: id
id.description: The item's id (a uuid, a package name@version or a key id).

pantherclaw.v1.ExposedItem.title: ExposedItem
pantherclaw.v1.ExposedItem.description: ExposedItem is one thing the person published since the mark's time.

pantherclaw.v1.ListCompromisesResponse.title: ListCompromisesResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ListCompromisesResponse.description: ListCompromisesResponse lists marks, newest first (at most 200).

items.title: items
items.description:
What the person published since its time, at most 1000 items per
 source.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description:
True when a source has more than it lists (1000 items): the list is
 not everything and the mark cannot be cleared (EXPOSURE_TRUNCATED).

pantherclaw.v1.ListExposedResponse.title: ListExposedResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ListExposedResponse.description: ListExposedResponse returns the mark and its items, oldest first.

state.title: state
state.description: Only this state; empty for every state.

category.title: category
category.description: Only this category; empty for every category.

pageToken.title: page_token
pageToken.description: Changes older than this one (from next_page_token).

pageSize.title: page_size
pageSize.description: At most this many (1 to 200; default 50).

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: The next page's token; empty at the end.

since.title: since
since.description: From when their actions count as exposed (not in the future).

change.title: change
change.description: The change (EMERGENCY, review_state DUE, a new review request).

pantherclaw.v1.OpenEmergencyReviewRespon.title: OpenEmergencyReviewResponse
pantherclaw.v1.OpenEmergencyReviewRespon.description: OpenEmergencyReviewResponse returns the change with its new review.

updatedBy.title: updated_by
updatedBy.description: Who last changed it; empty when never set.

surface.title: surface
surface.description: The surface that applies it (for example "credential.put").

summary.title: summary
summary.description: What a publisher sees: metadata and fingerprints, never secrets.

changeRequestId.title: change_request_id
changeRequestId.description: Its change request (confirmed on that request's page).

publisher.title: publisher
publisher.description: Who published it (confirmed it, or applied it in an emergency).

reviewRequestId.title: review_request_id
reviewRequestId.description: An emergency change's review: its request, due time and reviewer.

reviewDueTime.title: review_due_time
reviewDueTime.description: When the review is due (72 hours after the emergency).

reviewState.title: review_state

pantherclaw.v1.ProtectedChange.title: ProtectedChange
pantherclaw.v1.ProtectedChange.description: ProtectedChange is one stored protected change.

since.title: since
since.description: From when their actions are exposed.

clearRequestId.title: clear_request_id
clearRequestId.description: The pending or applied request to clear it.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeObservedBy.title: RangeObservedBy
pantherclaw.v1.RangeObservedBy.description: RangeObservedBy says who observed a step's result.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeState.title: RangeState
pantherclaw.v1.RangeState.description: RangeState is where a range is in its life.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeVerdict.title: RangeVerdict
pantherclaw.v1.RangeVerdict.description:
RangeVerdict is a scenario's verdict. MISSING is server-only: the
 scenario was declared and never recorded.

packId.title: pack_id
packId.description: pack_id is the evidence pack that holds the report.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeCounts.title: RangeCounts
pantherclaw.v1.RangeCounts.description: RangeCounts counts a range's scenarios by verdict.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeExpect.title: RangeExpect
pantherclaw.v1.RangeExpect.description:
RangeExpect is what a step expects, or what it observed. Outcome is one
 of ALLOW, DENY, HOLD, CANNOT_AUTHORIZE, REFUSED, BLOCKED, TARGET_REFUSED,
 NOT_FOUND, CONFIRMED, UNKNOWN. Reason and code may be empty (expected:
 not checked; observed: none).

claimedVerdict.title: claimed_verdict
claimedVerdict.description: claimed_verdict is the runner's claim when it differs from verdict.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeResult.title: RangeResult
pantherclaw.v1.RangeResult.description: RangeResult is one scenario's recorded result.

stepCount.title: step_count
stepCount.description:
step_count is how many steps the scenario has: a PASS records exactly
 that many (FAIL and ERROR may record fewer).

pantherclaw.v1.RangeScenarioDecl.title: RangeScenarioDecl
pantherclaw.v1.RangeScenarioDecl.description:
RangeScenarioDecl declares a scenario of the set a range runs. The
 digest is the SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the scenario's canonical form.

observed.title: observed
observed.description:
observed is what the server recorded: its own derivation for a
 SERVER step, the runner's claim for a CLIENT step.

mismatch.title: mismatch
mismatch.description:
mismatch: the runner's claim differed from the server's records and
 was overwritten.

claimed.title: claimed
claimed.description: claimed is the runner's claim when mismatch.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeStep.title: RangeStep
pantherclaw.v1.RangeStep.description: RangeStep is one step as the server recorded it.

transactionId.title: transaction_id
transactionId.description: transaction_id is the simulated transaction the step caused, if any.

probeReportId.title: probe_report_id
probeReportId.description:
probe_report_id is the sandbox probe report the step is based on, if
 any (a sandbox.probe step).

decisiveControl.title: decisive_control
decisiveControl.description: decisive_control is the rule the scenario says decides the step.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
kind is the scenario step kind (agent.call, wait, person.approve, ...).
 The server derives the observation from a cited transaction only for
 agent.* and wait steps that expect ALLOW, DENY, HOLD, CANNOT_AUTHORIZE,
 CONFIRMED or UNKNOWN; every other step is observed_by CLIENT and its
 transaction is only a reference that must belong to the range.

probeKind.title: probe_kind
probeKind.description:
probe_kind names the result of the cited probe report the step is
 based on (a sandbox.probe step's probe); required with probe_report_id.

pantherclaw.v1.RangeStepInput.title: RangeStepInput
pantherclaw.v1.RangeStepInput.description: RangeStepInput is one step as the runner recorded it.

verdict.title: verdict
verdict.description:
verdict is the runner's claim; the server recomputes PASS and FAIL
 from the steps (ERROR and SKIPPED are kept as claimed).

baselineRangeId.title: baseline_range_id
baselineRangeId.description: baseline_range_id is the finished range this one is compared with.

environment.title: environment
environment.description: The deployment environment, as a consequence names it.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: owner/name; empty for every repository of the environment.

timeZone.title: time_zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the weekly entries.

revision.title: revision
revision.description:
1 for an environment's and repository's first window, then one more
 for each that replaces it.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: owner/name in lowercase; empty for every repository.

pantherclaw.v1.CreateChangeWindowRequest.title: CreateChangeWindowRequest
pantherclaw.v1.CreateChangeWindowRequest.description: CreateChangeWindowRequest is a window to store.

pantherclaw.v1.GetActiveWindowsRequest.title: GetActiveWindowsRequest
pantherclaw.v1.GetActiveWindowsRequest.description: GetActiveWindowsRequest names a release's environment and repository.

state.title: state
state.description:
OPEN (a release approval counts now), CLOSED (outside the window),
 FROZEN (a freeze holds) or NO_WINDOW (none is configured).

windows.title: windows
windows.description: The active windows that apply: the environment's and the repository's.

pantherclaw.v1.GetActiveWindowsResponse.title: GetActiveWindowsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.GetActiveWindowsResponse.description: GetActiveWindowsResponse says what the windows allow now.

environment.title: environment
environment.description: Only this environment's windows when set.

pantherclaw.v1.ListChangeWindowsResponse.title: ListChangeWindowsResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ListChangeWindowsResponse.description:
ListChangeWindowsResponse lists windows, by environment, repository and
 newest revision first; at most 500.

pantherclaw.v1.RetireChangeWindowRequest.title: RetireChangeWindowRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RetireChangeWindowRequest.description: RetireChangeWindowRequest names a window and why it is retired.

pantherclaw.v1.TimeSpan.title: TimeSpan
pantherclaw.v1.TimeSpan.description: TimeSpan is a one-off window or a freeze, from its start up to its end.

day.title: day
day.description: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun.

start.title: start
start.description: HH:MM in the window's time zone.

pantherclaw.v1.WeeklyEntry.title: WeeklyEntry
pantherclaw.v1.WeeklyEntry.description:
WeeklyEntry opens a window every week on a day, from a local start time,
 for a number of minutes (possibly past midnight).

pantherclaw.v1.ApplyRestorationStageResp.title: ApplyRestorationStageResponse
pantherclaw.v1.ApplyRestorationStageResp.description: ApplyRestorationStageResponse is the results and the plan's state.

operation.title: operation
operation.description: The operation a DENY_OPERATION control denies.

previewDigest.title: preview_digest
previewDigest.description: Hex SHA-256 from PreviewContainment; required for a wider control.

skipPreview.title: skip_preview
skipPreview.description:
Emergency skip of a wider control's preview: needs skip_reason and a
 fresh security-key step-up of the calling browser session.

expireTime.title: expire_time
expireTime.description: When the control ends by itself; unset: until restored.

liftTime.title: lift_time
liftTime.description: Set once lifted, with the restoration plan that lifted it.

pantherclaw.v1.ContainmentControl.title: ContainmentControl
pantherclaw.v1.ContainmentControl.description: ContainmentControl is a control the Authority enforces until lifted.

pantherclaw.v1.ContainmentReach.title: ContainmentReach
pantherclaw.v1.ContainmentReach.description: ContainmentReach is the reach before and after (exposure).

pantherclaw.v1.DecideRestorationResponse.title: DecideRestorationResponse
pantherclaw.v1.DecideRestorationResponse.description: DecideRestorationResponse is the plan's new state.

permitState.title: permit_state
permitState.description: The permit's state when last read.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
"installation_tokens": GitHub App tokens minted before a rotation, still
 valid at GitHub until valid_until (D61); empty for a dispatch.

pantherclaw.v1.HistoricalItem.title: HistoricalItem
pantherclaw.v1.HistoricalItem.description:
HistoricalItem is work dispatched before the control (F561): stopping
 new access does not undo it.

pageToken.title: page_token
pageToken.description: The last action id of the previous page.

scope.title: scope
scope.description:
Only actions on this scope (a user or service account is its
 principal scope).

narrow.title: narrow
narrow.description: Whether it commits without a preview.

alternativePaths.title: alternative_paths
alternativePaths.description: Bypass routes ("agent:connection:operation") the control does not close.

previewDigest.title: preview_digest
previewDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical preview, hex: Contain's preview_digest.

reach.title: reach
reach.description: Unset below Team, or when it could not be computed (reach_note says).

version.title: version
version.description: 0: the credential the agent holds itself on an agent_held connection.

pantherclaw.v1.PreviewCredentialChangeRe.title: PreviewCredentialChangeRequest
pantherclaw.v1.PreviewCredentialChangeRe.description: PreviewCredentialChangeRequest names a sealed credential version.

everyAgent.title: every_agent
everyAgent.description: A route of the connection serves every agent.

sharedConnectionIds.title: shared_connection_ids
sharedConnectionIds.description: Connections sharing its GitHub App installation.

previewDigest.title: preview_digest
previewDigest.description: Hex SHA-256: the revoke or rotate's preview_digest.

pantherclaw.v1.ProposeResponseRequest.title: ProposeResponseRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ProposeResponseRequest.description: ProposeResponseRequest names what to respond to.

idempotencyKey.title: idempotency_key
idempotencyKey.description: Idempotent on (org, key): the same request returns the same action.

scope.title: scope
scope.description: A run, agent, grant or connection.

result.title: result
result.description:
"CONFIRMED", "FAILED", "UNSUPPORTED" or "UNKNOWN" (not yet confirmed
 on every path; see paths).

replayed.title: replayed
replayed.description: The key was used before for this same request.

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
Why a FAILED result created no action: "RATE_LIMITED" (more than 10
 grant or connection controls in the last hour).

stages.title: stages
stages.description: Stages make a staged restoration (Team): each control in one stage.

pantherclaw.v1.RequestRestorationRequest.title: RequestRestorationRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RequestRestorationRequest.description: RequestRestorationRequest names the controls to lift.

futureConfirmed.title: future_confirmed
futureConfirmed.description:
New access is stopped on every material path (F561, D52): false while
 a bypass route is open.

historicalOpen.title: historical_open
historicalOpen.description: Historical exposure, reported apart from new access (F561).

epoch.title: epoch
epoch.description: The containment epoch the change raised the org to.

previewDigest.title: preview_digest
previewDigest.description:
The preview computed at request time (hex), which a supplied digest
 matched, and whether a wider control's preview was skipped.

previewSummary.title: preview_summary
previewSummary.description: The known consequence at request time: counts and the first agent ids.

mediatedConfirmed.title: mediated_confirmed
mediatedConfirmed.description: Every gateway serving the scope was sent the action's epoch (D52).

pantherclaw.v1.ResponseAction.title: ResponseAction
pantherclaw.v1.ResponseAction.description: ResponseAction is one Contain, Terminate, Revoke or Rotate request.

pantherclaw.v1.ResponseOption.title: ResponseOption
pantherclaw.v1.ResponseOption.description: ResponseOption is one prefilled option, narrowest first.

subjectType.title: subject_type
subjectType.description:
What it is: a gateway, a connection route ("agent:connection:operation"),
 a credential's connection or a transaction.

material.title: material
material.description: A material path decides the action's status.

control.title: control
control.description:
How it is enforced or why it is open: "epoch", a coverage state
 ("ENFORCED", "PARTIAL", "OBSERVE_ONLY", "UNKNOWN"), "agent_held",
 a credential kind or "dispatched".

evidence.title: evidence
evidence.description: Confirmation evidence: ids, epochs and times only.

failure.title: failure
failure.description: Why it failed, or why it cannot be reached.

pantherclaw.v1.ResponsePath.title: ResponsePath
pantherclaw.v1.ResponsePath.description: ResponsePath is one path an action must reach (F288).

id.title: id
id.description:
A uuid, or for a resource "<target type>:<target id>" where a trailing
 * matches a prefix.

pantherclaw.v1.ResponseSubject.title: ResponseSubject
pantherclaw.v1.ResponseSubject.description: ResponseSubject is what a control or proposal is about.

pantherclaw.v1.RestorationStage.title: RestorationStage
pantherclaw.v1.RestorationStage.description: RestorationStage is one stage as recorded.

pantherclaw.v1.RestorationStageSpec.title: RestorationStageSpec
pantherclaw.v1.RestorationStageSpec.description: RestorationStageSpec is one stage of a staged restoration.

pantherclaw.v1.RestorationTestAction.title: RestorationTestAction
pantherclaw.v1.RestorationTestAction.description: RestorationTestAction is a recorded evaluation re-decided, dry run.

version.title: version
version.description:
0: the credential the agent holds itself on an agent_held connection,
 which only an upstream attestation revokes.

upstreamRevoked.title: upstream_revoked
upstreamRevoked.description:
The person attests the credential was revoked at its provider (D61):
 needs a security-key step-up of the calling browser session and a note.
 Without it a revoked copy leaves the upstream path UNRESOLVED.

pantherclaw.v1.RevokeSealedCredentialReq.title: RevokeSealedCredentialRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RevokeSealedCredentialReq.description: RevokeSealedCredentialRequest names the version and its preview.

version.title: version
version.description: 0: the credential the agent holds itself (see RevokeSealedCredential).

upstreamRevoked.title: upstream_revoked
upstreamRevoked.description:
The person attests the credential was revoked at its provider (D61):
 needs a security-key step-up of the calling browser session and a note.
 Without it a revoked copy leaves the upstream path UNRESOLVED.

pantherclaw.v1.RotateSealedCredentialReq.title: RotateSealedCredentialRequest
pantherclaw.v1.RotateSealedCredentialReq.description: RotateSealedCredentialRequest names the version and its preview.

pantherclaw.v1.SandboxRouteKind.title: SandboxRouteKind
pantherclaw.v1.SandboxRouteKind.description: SandboxRouteKind is what the edge saw.

pantherclaw.v1.SandboxSessionState.title: SandboxSessionState
pantherclaw.v1.SandboxSessionState.description: SandboxSessionState is where a session is in its life.

pantherclaw.v1.ProbeNonces.title: ProbeNonces
pantherclaw.v1.ProbeNonces.description:
ProbeNonces are fresh single-use server nonces, one for each report of a
 probe run, valid 15 minutes.

newRoutes.title: new_routes
newRoutes.description: new_routes counts the routes seen for the first time.

failed.title: failed
failed.description: failed names the results that kept it from passing.

pantherclaw.v1.SandboxClosure.title: SandboxClosure
pantherclaw.v1.SandboxClosure.description: SandboxClosure is the closure recorded for one mapped connection.

pantherclaw.v1.SandboxEngine.title: SandboxEngine
pantherclaw.v1.SandboxEngine.description: SandboxEngine is the Docker engine a session runs on (HR-218).

pantherclaw.v1.SandboxImages.title: SandboxImages
pantherclaw.v1.SandboxImages.description: SandboxImages are the digests of a session's images.

pantherclaw.v1.SandboxRoute.title: SandboxRoute
pantherclaw.v1.SandboxRoute.description: SandboxRoute is one route the edge saw. The locator is untrusted.

probePublicKey.title: probe_public_key
probePublicKey.description:
probe_public_key is the raw Ed25519 public key of the probe key, which
 signs only the sandbox report; host_public_key that of the host key,
 which never enters a container and signs the control and canary
 reports (HR-215). They differ.

ttl.title: ttl
ttl.description: ttl is how long the session lasts; at most and by default 24 hours.

enrollmentToken.title: enrollment_token
enrollmentToken.description:
enrollment_token enrolls the sandbox instance's key (pclaw workload
 enroll); single use, shown once, valid 15 minutes.

agentHosts.title: agent_hosts
agentHosts.description:
agent_hosts maps each host agents use to its connection's name: the
 edge's mapping (connections' agent_hosts).

launcher.title: launcher
launcher.description: launcher is the person or service account that opened it.

instanceId.title: instance_id
instanceId.description: instance_id is the sandbox instance, once it enrolled; run_id its run.

probeKeyThumbprint.title: probe_key_thumbprint
probeKeyThumbprint.description:
probe_key_thumbprint and host_key_thumbprint are the RFC 7638
 thumbprints of the probe and host keys.

nextNonces.title: next_nonces
nextNonces.description: next_nonces are for a re-probe in the same session.

report.title: report
report.description: report is the signed report, a compact JWS (typ pap-probe+jwt).

runId.title: run_id
runId.description:
run_id is the run the sandbox instance works in, bound on the first
 report; it must be the instance's.

failed.title: failed
failed.description: failed names the results that were not as expected.

pantherclaw.v1.CredentialState.title: CredentialState
pantherclaw.v1.CredentialState.description: CredentialState is the state of a key or API key.

pantherclaw.v1.KeyAlgorithm.title: KeyAlgorithm
pantherclaw.v1.KeyAlgorithm.description: KeyAlgorithm is the algorithm pinned on a service-account key.

algorithm.title: algorithm
algorithm.description: Algorithm to pin on the key.

publicJwk.title: public_jwk
publicJwk.description: Public JWK (Ed25519 for EdDSA, P-256 for ES256).

hint.title: hint
hint.description: Last four characters of the key, to recognize it.

scopes.title: scopes
scopes.description: Permissions the key may use (intersected with the account's roles).

lastUseTime.title: last_use_time
lastUseTime.description: Last use (updated at most once a minute).

pantherclaw.v1.ApiKey.title: ApiKey
pantherclaw.v1.ApiKey.description: ApiKey is a scoped bearer key of a service account.

scopes.title: scopes
scopes.description: Permissions the key may use; human-only permissions are rejected.

secret.title: secret
secret.description: The key (pck_…). It is shown only once.

pantherclaw.v1.CreateApiKeyResponse.title: CreateApiKeyResponse
pantherclaw.v1.CreateApiKeyResponse.description: CreateApiKeyResponse returns the key and its secret.

name.title: name
name.description: Unique name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

serviceAccountId.title: service_account_id
serviceAccountId.description: Only keys of this service account.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

pantherclaw.v1.ListServiceAccountKeysReq.title: ListServiceAccountKeysRequest
pantherclaw.v1.ListServiceAccountKeysReq.description: ListServiceAccountKeysRequest lists a service account's keys.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty on the last page.

clientId.title: client_id
clientId.description: OAuth client id for the client-credentials grant (pcsa_…).

kid.title: kid
kid.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint; the "kid" header of client assertions.

pantherclaw.v1.ServiceAccountKey.title: ServiceAccountKey
pantherclaw.v1.ServiceAccountKey.description: ServiceAccountKey is a registered public key.

pantherclaw.v1.SetServiceAccountStateReq.title: SetServiceAccountStateRequest
pantherclaw.v1.SetServiceAccountStateReq.description: SetServiceAccountStateRequest disables or re-enables a service account.

pantherclaw.v1.UpdateServiceAccountReque.title: UpdateServiceAccountRequest
pantherclaw.v1.UpdateServiceAccountReque.description: UpdateServiceAccountRequest changes the fields that are set.

jwksUri.title: jwks_uri
jwksUri.description: The https JWKS URI, on the issuer's host.

audience.title: audience
audience.description: The audience; unset: the endpoint URL.

events.title: events
events.description: The event type URIs it acts on.

version.title: version
version.description: Its version (each applied request adds one).

requestId.title: request_id
requestId.description: The request that set it; empty when never changed.

credentialId.title: credential_id
credentialId.description: The security key that signed the request's binding.

events.title: events
events.description: The event type URIs it would act on (none for DISABLE).

required.title: required
required.description: Confirmations required: 2 to enable or change, 1 to disable.

createTime.title: create_time
createTime.description: When it was asked and when it expires (24 hours).

decidedReason.title: decided_reason
decidedReason.description: Why it ended (untrusted text for a decline).

confirmUrl.title: confirm_url
confirmUrl.description: The page where people confirm it.

pantherclaw.v1.IdentityPlaybookRequest.title: IdentityPlaybookRequest
pantherclaw.v1.IdentityPlaybookRequest.description: IdentityPlaybookRequest is a playbook change and its confirmations.

nextPageToken.title: next_page_token
nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty at the end.

events.title: events
events.description:
The event type URIs to act on: 1 to 6 for ENABLE and CHANGE, none for
 DISABLE.

userId.title: user_id
userId.description: The person it matched; empty when none did.

caseId.title: case_id
caseId.description: The case it opened; empty when none.

pantherclaw.v1.SSFEvent.title: SSFEvent
pantherclaw.v1.SSFEvent.description:
SSFEvent is one received event: what it was and whom it matched, never
 the token or the subject's identifiers.

issuer.title: issuer
issuer.description: The issuer (iss) its tokens must carry.

jwksUri.title: jwks_uri
jwksUri.description: Its signing keys, on the issuer's host.

audience.title: audience
audience.description: The audience (aud) its tokens must name.

confirmUrl.title: confirm_url
confirmUrl.description: The page where a person activates it.

activatedBy.title: activated_by
activatedBy.description: Who activated it with a security key.

internal.title: internal

pantherclaw.v1.WaitlistSettings.description:

pantherclaw.v1.AttestationKind.description: AttestationKind names the preset an attestation token is for.

pantherclaw.v1.Attestation.description:
